<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">
<title>TMGame - User Panel</title>
<style>
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
body{font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,Arial,sans-serif;background:#f1f5f9;color:#0f172a;min-height:100vh;padding-bottom:calc(88px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}
button,input,select,textarea{font-family:inherit}
button{border:0;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .12s ease,opacity .12s ease}
button:active{transform:scale(.96);opacity:.88}
input,select,textarea{outline:none}
.hidden{display:none!important}

/* AUTH */
.auth-page{min-height:calc(100vh - 88px - env(safe-area-inset-bottom));display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:22px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#f8fafc,#e0e7ff)}
.auth-box{width:100%;max-width:420px;background:#fff;border-radius:28px;padding:30px 24px;box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.08)}
.logo{font-size:30px;font-weight:900}
.logo span{color:#4f46e5}
.auth-title{font-size:24px;margin-top:26px;margin-bottom:6px;font-weight:800}
.auth-sub{color:#64748b;margin-bottom:22px;font-size:14px}
.field{margin-bottom:14px}
.field label{display:block;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:6px;color:#334155}
.field input{width:100%;height:52px;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:14px;padding:0 16px;font-size:15px}
.primary-btn{width:100%;height:52px;border-radius:14px;background:#4f46e5;color:#fff;font-size:16px;font-weight:800;margin-top:6px}
.auth-switch{text-align:center;margin-top:18px;color:#64748b;font-size:14px}
.auth-switch button{background:none;color:#4f46e5;font-weight:800}

/* HEADER */
.app-header{height:70px;background:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:0 18px;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:30;box-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.05)}
.header-logo{font-size:22px;font-weight:900}
.header-user{color:#64748b;font-size:14px;max-width:130px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}

/* MAIN */
.main{max-width:640px;margin:0 auto;padding:16px}

/* PAGES */
.page{display:none}
.page.active{display:block}

/* CARDS */
.card{background:#fff;border-radius:22px;padding:20px;margin-bottom:16px;box-shadow:0 4px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.04)}
.section-title{font-size:20px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:14px}

/* WALLET */
.wallet-card{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#4f46e5,#6366f1);color:#fff;border-radius:24px;padding:22px;margin-bottom:18px}
.wallet-label{opacity:.85;font-size:14px}
.wallet-balance{font-size:32px;font-weight:900;margin:6px 0 18px}
.wallet-actions{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}
.wallet-actions button{height:46px;border-radius:14px;font-size:14px;font-weight:800}
.deposit-btn{background:#fff;color:#4f46e5}
.withdraw-btn{background:rgba(255,255,255,.18);color:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3)}

/* TOURNAMENT */
.tournament-card{background:#fff;border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:16px;box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.05)}
.tournament-banner{width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;object-fit:cover;background:#e2e8f0;display:block}
.tournament-body{padding:16px}
.tournament-name{font-size:17px;font-weight:800}
.badge{padding:5px 10px;border-radius:20px;font-size:11px;font-weight:800}
.badge-free{background:#dcfce7;color:#166534}
.badge-paid{background:#ffedd5;color:#9a3412}
.info-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;margin:12px 0}
.info-box{background:#f8fafc;border-radius:12px;padding:10px}
.info-label{font-size:11px;color:#64748b;margin-bottom:2px}
.info-value{font-size:13px;font-weight:700}
.join-btn{width:100%;height:46px;border-radius:13px;background:#4f46e5;color:#fff;font-weight:800;font-size:14px}
.join-btn.disabled{background:#e2e8f0;color:#94a3b8}

/* SEAT GRID */
.seat-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:8px;margin:16px 0}
.seat{height:42px;border-radius:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:800;font-size:14px;background:#f1f5f9;color:#334155;border:2px solid transparent}
.seat.available{background:#f1f5f9;cursor:pointer}
.seat.available:active{background:#e0e7ff}
.seat.selected{background:#4f46e5;color:#fff;border-color:#4338ca}
.seat.taken{background:#fecaca;color:#991b1b;cursor:not-allowed;opacity:.7}
.seat.mine{background:#bbf7d0;color:#166534;border-color:#16a34a}

/* FILTER */
.filter-row{display:flex;gap:8px;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:8px;margin-bottom:12px}
.filter-row::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.filter{white-space:nowrap;padding:9px 14px;border-radius:20px;background:#fff;color:#64748b;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;border:1px solid #e2e8f0}
.filter.active{background:#4f46e5;color:#fff;border-color:#4f46e5}

/* FORMS */
.form-input{width:100%;height:50px;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:14px;padding:0 15px;font-size:15px;background:#fff;margin-bottom:12px}
.form-btn{width:100%;height:50px;border-radius:14px;background:#4f46e5;color:#fff;font-size:15px;font-weight:800}
.form-btn:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:not-allowed}

/* NOTICE */
.notice{padding:12px 14px;background:#eef2ff;color:#4338ca;border-radius:13px;font-size:13px;margin-bottom:12px}
.warning{padding:12px 14px;background:#fef3c7;color:#92400e;border-radius:13px;font-size:13px;margin-bottom:12px}
.block-notice{padding:14px;background:#fef2f2;color:#b91c1c;border:1px solid #fecaca;border-radius:14px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5;margin-bottom:14px}

/* HISTORY */
.history-item{padding:14px 0;border-top:1px solid #e2e8f0}
.history-item:first-child{border-top:0}
.history-line{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin-bottom:6px}
.history-label{color:#64748b;font-size:13px}
.history-value{font-weight:700;text-align:right;word-break:break-word;font-size:13px}
.status{display:inline-block;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:20px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700}
.status-pending{background:#fef3c7;color:#92400e}
.status-approved,.status-paid{background:#dcfce7;color:#166534}
.status-rejected{background:#fee2e2;color:#991b1b}

/* MATCH / MY TOURNAMENTS */
.match-card{background:#fff;border-radius:18px;padding:16px;margin-bottom:14px;box-shadow:0 3px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.04)}
.match-title{font-size:16px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:10px}
.room-box{margin-top:12px;padding:14px;border-radius:14px;background:#eef2ff}
.prize-card{border-radius:16px;padding:16px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fefce8,#fff);border:1px solid #fde68a;margin-top:12px}
.prize-amount{font-size:26px;font-weight:900;margin:4px 0}

/* PROFILE */
.profile-avatar{width:72px;height:72px;border-radius:50%;background:#4f46e5;color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:28px;font-weight:900;margin-bottom:14px}
.profile-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;padding:13px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #e2e8f0}
.profile-row:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.profile-label{color:#64748b;font-size:14px}
.profile-value{font-weight:700;text-align:right;word-break:break-word;font-size:14px}


/* GAME CATEGORY SLIDER */
.cat-slider{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;padding:4px 2px 14px}
/* no-match category tone */
.cat-card.no-match{background:#2a2f3a!important;border-color:#3a4150!important;box-shadow:0 6px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.25)!important}
.cat-card.no-match .cat-thumb{filter:none}
.cat-card.no-match .cat-name{color:#f1f5f9}
.cat-card.no-match .cat-dot{background:#8b90a0;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(58,63,75,.12)}
.cat-card{min-width:0;background:#fff;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(15,23,42,.08);padding:8px;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;display:block}
.cat-thumb{position:relative;border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;aspect-ratio:16/9;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#312e81,#1e3a8a)}
.cat-thumb img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;filter:none!important;opacity:1!important}
.cat-fallback{width:100%;height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:36px}
.cat-meta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:10px 4px 4px}
.cat-name{min-width:0;color:#1e293b;font-size:13px;font-weight:800;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.cat-dot{width:10px;height:10px;flex:0 0 10px;border-radius:50%;background:#4f46e5;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(79,70,229,.12)}
.cat-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:12px}
.cat-head .back-btn{flex:none}
.category-type-filter{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-bottom:14px}
.category-type-filter .filter{min-width:82px;border-color:#2563eb;color:#2563eb;background:#eff6ff}
.category-type-filter .filter.active{border-color:#2563eb;color:#fff;background:#2563eb;box-shadow:0 7px 14px rgba(37,99,235,.2)}
.network-modal{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:10000;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:24px;background:rgba(15,23,42,.62);backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}
.network-modal-box{width:100%;max-width:340px;padding:26px 22px;border-radius:20px;background:#fff;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 24px 60px rgba(15,23,42,.28)}
.network-modal-icon{width:52px;height:52px;margin:0 auto 14px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:#eff6ff;color:#2563eb;font-size:25px;font-weight:900}
.network-modal-title{font-size:19px;font-weight:900;color:#11182d}

/* NAV */
.bottom-nav{position:fixed;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:78px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.97);border-top:1px solid #e2e8f0;display:flex;justify-content:space-around;align-items:center;z-index:100;backdrop-filter:blur(12px)}
.nav-btn{flex:1;height:100%;background:none;color:#64748b;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:3px;font-size:10px;font-weight:650}
.nav-icon{font-size:22px;line-height:1}
.nav-btn.active{color:#4f46e5}

/* EMPTY */
.empty{text-align:center;padding:30px 15px;color:#64748b}
.empty-icon{font-size:36px;margin-bottom:8px}

/* MODAL */
.modal{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(15,23,42,.5);display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;z-index:300}
.modal-box{width:100%;max-width:520px;max-height:90vh;overflow:auto;background:#fff;border-radius:24px 24px 0 0;padding:22px}
.modal-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:16px}
.modal-title{font-size:20px;font-weight:900}
.close-btn{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;background:#f1f5f9;font-size:18px}

/* TOAST */
.toast{position:fixed;left:16px;right:16px;bottom:90px;background:#0f172a;color:#fff;padding:13px 16px;border-radius:14px;text-align:center;font-size:14px;z-index:500;transform:translateY(20px);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:.25s}
.toast.show{transform:translateY(0);opacity:1}

/* NOTIFICATION */
.notif-item{padding:14px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #e2e8f0}
.notif-item.unread{background:#f8fafc;margin:0 -8px;padding:14px 8px;border-radius:12px}
.notif-title{font-weight:800;font-size:15px}
.notif-msg{color:#475569;font-size:13px;margin:4px 0}
.notif-time{font-size:11px;color:#94a3b8}

/* SUPPORT */
.ticket-card{background:#fff;border-radius:16px;padding:16px;margin-bottom:12px;box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.04)}
.ticket-subject{font-weight:800;margin-bottom:4px}
.ticket-meta{font-size:12px;color:#64748b;margin-bottom:8px}
.ticket-msg{background:#f8fafc;padding:12px;border-radius:12px;font-size:13px;margin-bottom:8px}
.admin-reply{background:#e0e7ff;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:12px;font-size:13px;margin-top:6px}

/* REFERRAL */
.ref-code-box{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#4f46e5,#6366f1);color:#fff;border-radius:18px;padding:20px;text-align:center;margin-bottom:16px}
.ref-code{font-size:28px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:2px;margin:10px 0}
.copy-ref{background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);color:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3);padding:10px 20px;border-radius:12px;font-weight:700}

/* PULL TO REFRESH */
.ptr-indicator{position:fixed;top:8px;left:50%;transform:translate3d(-50%,var(--ptr-y,-64px),0);width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;color:#0f172a;font-size:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(15,23,42,.18);z-index:60;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;will-change:transform,opacity;transition:transform .3s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),opacity .18s ease;backface-visibility:hidden}
.ptr-indicator::before{content:"";width:20px;height:20px;border:3px solid #dbe4f0;border-top-color:#2563eb;border-radius:50%;transform:rotate(var(--ptr-rotation,0deg));will-change:transform}
.ptr-indicator.visible{opacity:1}
.ptr-indicator.dragging{transition:none}
.ptr-indicator.spinning::before{animation:tmspin .7s linear infinite}
.ptr-indicator.retracting{transition:transform .32s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1),opacity .2s ease .1s}
@keyframes tmspin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ptr-indicator{transition-duration:.01ms}.ptr-indicator.spinning::before{animation-duration:1.2s}}
.copy-mini{margin-left:8px;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:9px;background:#eff6ff;color:#2563eb;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;border:1px solid #dbeafe}
.match-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin-bottom:10px}
.parts-btn{flex:none;padding:7px 12px;border-radius:10px;background:#eff6ff;color:#2563eb;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;border:1px solid #dbeafe}
.copy-line{display:inline-flex;align-items:center}

/* PARTICIPANTS */
.participant-item{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #e2e8f0;font-size:13px}
.participant-item:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.participant-info{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px}
.participant-name{font-weight:700}
.participant-seat{color:#64748b;font-size:12px}
.participant-result{font-weight:700;font-size:12px}
.participant-result.win{color:#16a34a}
.participant-result.loss{color:#b91c1c}

@media(max-width:400px){
  .main{padding:12px}
  .wallet-balance{font-size:28px}
  .seat-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:6px}
  .seat{height:38px;font-size:13px}
}

/* Premium visual layer — functionality and selectors remain unchanged */
:root{
  --ink:#11182d;
  --muted:#718099;
  --line:#e6eaf2;
  --brand:#5b4cf0;
  --brand-deep:#4032bf;
  --brand-soft:#eeedff;
  --mint:#27c6b4;
  --shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(25,33,72,.07);
  --shadow-hover:0 20px 44px rgba(25,33,72,.13);
}
html{background:#f4f6fb;scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 100% -5%,rgba(91,76,240,.1),transparent 22rem),
    linear-gradient(135deg,#f9faff 0%,#f1f4fa 100%);
  color:var(--ink);
  letter-spacing:-.012em;
}
body:before{
  content:"";
  position:fixed;
  inset:0;
  pointer-events:none;
  opacity:.3;
  background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(91,76,240,.024) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(91,76,240,.024) 1px,transparent 1px);
  background-size:34px 34px;
  mask-image:linear-gradient(to bottom,#000,transparent 82%);
}
button,input,select,textarea{transition:background-color .2s ease,border-color .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease,transform .2s ease,opacity .2s ease}
button:focus-visible,input:focus-visible,select:focus-visible,textarea:focus-visible{outline:3px solid rgba(91,76,240,.2);outline-offset:2px}
.auth-page{
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 12% 10%,rgba(117,103,255,.35),transparent 25rem),
    radial-gradient(circle at 92% 90%,rgba(39,198,180,.2),transparent 23rem),
    linear-gradient(140deg,#0d1429,#1b1b4c 58%,#251d61);
}
.auth-page:before,.auth-page:after{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  width:24rem;
  height:24rem;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
  border-radius:50%;
  pointer-events:none;
}
.auth-page:before{top:-12rem;right:-8rem;box-shadow:0 0 0 42px rgba(255,255,255,.025),0 0 0 84px rgba(255,255,255,.018)}
.auth-page:after{bottom:-15rem;left:-9rem}
.auth-box{
  position:relative;
  z-index:1;
  max-width:430px;
  padding:38px 30px;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.72);
  border-radius:30px;
  box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.34),0 0 0 8px rgba(255,255,255,.04);
  animation:panelIn .55s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) both;
}
.logo{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#6758ff,#36cfc2);
  -webkit-background-clip:text;
  background-clip:text;
  color:transparent;
  letter-spacing:-.05em;
}
.auth-title{color:#151c34;letter-spacing:-.045em}
.auth-sub{color:#7b879c}
.field label{color:#65718a;letter-spacing:.02em}
.field input,.form-input{
  border-color:#dfe4ee;
  background:#fbfcfe;
  color:var(--ink);
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px 1px rgba(15,24,48,.02);
}
.field input::placeholder,.form-input::placeholder{color:#a0a9b9}
.field input:hover,.form-input:hover{border-color:#cbd1e2}
.field input:focus,.form-input:focus,textarea:focus{
  border-color:var(--brand);
  background:#fff;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(91,76,240,.12),0 8px 18px rgba(50,44,140,.05);
}
.primary-btn,.form-btn{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#6758ff,#4f3ed7);
  border:1px solid rgba(63,50,191,.16);
  box-shadow:0 10px 20px rgba(79,62,215,.2);
}
.primary-btn:hover,.form-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 14px 26px rgba(79,62,215,.27);filter:saturate(1.08)}
.primary-btn:active,.form-btn:active{transform:translateY(0) scale(.985)}
.primary-btn:disabled,.form-btn:disabled{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#a5a9bf,#878da8);box-shadow:none;opacity:.72}
.auth-switch{color:#7c879b}
.auth-switch button{color:var(--brand)}
.app-header{
  height:74px;
  padding:0 20px;
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(226,230,239,.84);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.87);
  box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(24,32,65,.05);
  backdrop-filter:blur(18px);
}
.header-logo{letter-spacing:-.05em}
.header-user{
  padding:8px 12px;
  border:1px solid #e6e9f1;
  border-radius:999px;
  background:#fafbfe;
  color:#64708a;
}
.main{padding:20px 16px 110px}
.page.active{animation:pageIn .35s ease both}
.section-title{color:#17203a;letter-spacing:-.04em}
.card,.tournament-card,.match-card,.ticket-card{
  border:1px solid rgba(226,230,239,.9);
  box-shadow:var(--shadow);
}
.card{border-radius:22px}
.wallet-card{
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;
  padding:25px;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 92% 8%,rgba(65,222,201,.32),transparent 12rem),
    linear-gradient(135deg,#5140dd 0%,#6555f1 54%,#4035bd 100%);
  box-shadow:0 18px 34px rgba(67,54,190,.24);
}
.wallet-card:before,.wallet-card:after{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.13);
  border-radius:50%;
  pointer-events:none;
}
.wallet-card:before{width:13rem;height:13rem;right:-5rem;top:-7rem}
.wallet-card:after{width:9rem;height:9rem;right:2rem;bottom:-6rem}
.wallet-label{opacity:.78;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:11px}
.wallet-balance{font-size:36px;letter-spacing:-.045em}
.wallet-actions button{box-shadow:0 7px 14px rgba(15,18,68,.12)}
.deposit-btn{background:#fff;color:var(--brand-deep)}
.deposit-btn:hover{background:#f5f3ff;transform:translateY(-2px)}
.withdraw-btn{background:rgba(255,255,255,.15);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.38)}
.withdraw-btn:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.25);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.block-notice{border-color:#ffcdd4;background:#fff1f3;color:#b52d43;box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(181,45,67,.06)}
.notice{border:1px solid #dfdcff;background:#f2f1ff;color:#4b3dc1}
.warning{border:1px solid #f7df9b;background:#fff8df;color:#966400}
.tournament-card{border-radius:21px;transition:transform .24s ease,box-shadow .24s ease}
.tournament-card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:var(--shadow-hover)}
.tournament-banner{background:#e8eaf2}
.tournament-body{padding:19px}

/* ==================== SPLASH / LOADING SCREEN (premium white + blue) ==================== */
.splash-screen{
  position:fixed;
  inset:0;
  z-index:9999;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;
  overflow:hidden;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 6%,rgba(79,70,229,.18),transparent 28rem),
    radial-gradient(circle at 6% 94%,rgba(56,189,248,.16),transparent 24rem),
    linear-gradient(155deg,#ffffff 0%,#f6f9ff 46%,#e9f1ff 100%);
  transition:opacity .5s ease,visibility .5s ease;
}
.splash-screen:before{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  inset:0;
  pointer-events:none;
  opacity:.6;
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(rgba(79,70,229,.055) 1px,transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(79,70,229,.055) 1px,transparent 1px);
  background-size:38px 38px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 42%,#000 0%,transparent 74%);
  mask-image:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 42%,#000 0%,transparent 74%);
}
.splash-screen:after{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  width:30rem;
  height:30rem;
  right:-15rem;
  top:-16rem;
  border-radius:50%;
  border:1px solid rgba(79,70,229,.1);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 46px rgba(79,70,229,.03),0 0 0 92px rgba(79,70,229,.018);
  pointer-events:none;
}
.splash-inner{
  position:relative;
  z-index:2;
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;
  align-items:center;
  text-align:center;
  padding:0 26px;
  animation:splashIn .75s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) both;
}
.splash-mark{
  position:relative;
  width:92px;
  height:92px;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;
  margin-bottom:24px;
}
.splash-ring{
  position:absolute;
  inset:0;
  border-radius:50%;
  border:3px solid rgba(79,70,229,.1);
  border-top-color:#4f46e5;
  border-right-color:#5eb4ff;
  animation:splashSpin 1s linear infinite;
}
.splash-ring.alt{
  inset:13px;
  border-width:2px;
  border-color:rgba(79,70,229,.07);
  border-bottom-color:#8b7cff;
  animation:splashSpin 1.5s linear reverse infinite;
}
.splash-core{
  font-size:22px;
  font-weight:900;
  letter-spacing:-.06em;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#2b3fa8,#4f46e5 55%,#5eb4ff);
  -webkit-background-clip:text;
  background-clip:text;
  color:transparent;
}
.splash-logo{
  font-size:43px;
  font-weight:900;
  letter-spacing:-.06em;
  line-height:1;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1e2a72 0%,#4f46e5 46%,#5eb4ff 100%);
  -webkit-background-clip:text;
  background-clip:text;
  color:transparent;
  -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;
}
.splash-tagline{
  margin-top:12px;
  color:#7a869c;
  font-size:11.5px;
  font-weight:800;
  letter-spacing:.16em;
  text-transform:uppercase;
}
.splash-bar{
  width:190px;
  height:4px;
  margin-top:28px;
  border-radius:99px;
  background:rgba(79,70,229,.12);
  overflow:hidden;
}
.splash-bar i{
  display:block;
  height:100%;
  width:40%;
  border-radius:99px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#4f46e5,#5eb4ff);
  animation:splashBar 1.3s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.splash-note{
  position:absolute;
  left:0;
  right:0;
  bottom:calc(30px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
  z-index:2;
  text-align:center;
  color:#98a2b8;
  font-size:12px;
  font-weight:600;
  letter-spacing:.02em;
}
.splash-screen.splash-hide{opacity:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none}
@keyframes splashSpin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
@keyframes splashBar{0%{transform:translateX(-115%)}100%{transform:translateX(265%)}}
@keyframes splashIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(16px) scale(.97)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@media(max-width:380px){
  .splash-logo{font-size:37px}
  .splash-mark{width:80px;height:80px}
}

<body>

<!-- ==================== SPLASH / LOADING ==================== -->
<div id="splashScreen" class="splash-screen">
  <div class="splash-inner">
    <div class="splash-mark">
      <div class="splash-ring"></div>
      <div class="splash-ring alt"></div>
      <div class="splash-core">TM</div>
    </div>
    <div class="splash-logo">TM<span>Game</span></div>
    <div class="splash-tagline">Premium Tournaments</div>
    <div class="splash-bar"><i></i></div>
  </div>
  <div class="splash-note">Loading your experience…</div>
</div>

<!-- ==================== AUTH ==================== -->
<div id="authPage" class="auth-page hidden">
  <div class="auth-box">
    <div class="logo">TM<span>Game</span></div>

    <div id="loginBox">
      <h1 class="auth-title">Welcome Back</h1>
      <p class="auth-sub">Login to continue</p>
      <div class="field"><label>Email</label><input id="loginEmail" type="email" autocomplete="email" placeholder="Enter your email"></div>
      <div class="field"><label>Password</label><input id="loginPassword" type="password" autocomplete="current-password" placeholder="Enter password"></div>
      <button class="primary-btn" onclick="window.loginUser()">Login</button>
      <div class="auth-switch">Don't have an account? <button onclick="window.showRegister()">Register</button></div>
    </div>

    <div id="registerBox" class="hidden">
      <h1 class="auth-title">Create Account</h1>
      <p class="auth-sub">Join TMGame</p>
      <div class="field"><label>Name</label><input id="registerName" type="text" maxlength="24" placeholder="Your name"></div>
      <div class="auth-hint">Name must be unique - it can't match another player.</div>
      <div class="field"><label>Email</label><input id="registerEmail" type="email" placeholder="Your email"></div>
      <div class="field"><label>Phone (10 digits)</label><input id="registerPhone" type="tel" inputmode="numeric" maxlength="10" placeholder="Enter 10 digit mobile number"></div>
      <div class="auth-hint">Only 10 digits allowed and each number can be used once.</div>
      <div class="field"><label>Password</label><input id="registerPassword" type="password" autocomplete="new-password" minlength="6" placeholder="Enter password"></div>
      <div class="field"><label>Referral Code (Optional)</label><input id="registerReferral" type="text" placeholder="Enter referral code if any"></div>
      <button class="primary-btn" onclick="window.registerUser()">Create Account</button>
      <div class="auth-switch">Already have an account? <button onclick="window.showLogin()">Login</button></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ==================== APP ==================== -->
<div id="app" class="hidden">
  <header class="app-header">
    <div id="headerName" class="header-logo">User</div>
    <button id="ptrIndicator" class="ptr-indicator" type="button" onclick="window.refreshAllData()" aria-label="Refresh data" title="Refresh data">⟳</button>
    <div class="header-actions">
      <button id="headerNotification" class="header-notification-btn" type="button" onclick="window.openNotifications()" aria-label="Notifications">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 8a6 6 0 0 0-12 0c0 7-3 7-3 9h18c0-2-3-2-3-9"></path><path d="M13.7 21a2 2 0 0 1-3.4 0"></path></svg>
      </button>
      <button id="headerUser" class="header-user header-menu-btn" type="button" onclick="window.toggleUserMenu()" aria-label="Open menu" aria-expanded="false"><span aria-hidden="true">☰</span></button>
    </div>
  </header>

  <main class="main">

    <!-- HOME -->
    <section id="page-home" class="page active home-glass-stage">
      <div id="creditAlert" class="credit-alert hidden" role="status"></div>
      <div id="homeBannerWrap" class="tm-banner-wrap hidden" aria-label="TMGame featured banners">
        <div id="homeBannerTrack" class="tm-banner-track"></div>
        <button id="homeBannerPrev" class="tm-banner-arrow tm-banner-prev" type="button" aria-label="Previous banner">‹</button>
        <button id="homeBannerNext" class="tm-banner-arrow tm-banner-next" type="button" aria-label="Next banner">›</button>
        <div id="homeBannerDots" class="tm-banner-dots" aria-label="Banner position"></div>
      </div>
      <div id="homeBlockNotice" class="block-notice hidden" style="margin-bottom:16px">
        🔒 Your account has been blocked by TMGame. You can only access Customer Support.
      </div>
      <div id="categorySection">
        <div class="section-title category-section-title">Game Category</div>
        <div id="categorySlider" class="cat-slider"></div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <!-- TOURNAMENTS -->
    <section id="page-tournaments" class="page">
      <div class="section-title">Tournaments</div>
      <div id="tournamentBlockNotice" class="block-notice hidden">
        🔒 Your account is restricted. Contact support or wait for TMGame approval.
      </div>
      <div class="filter-row">
        <button class="filter active" onclick="window.setTournamentFilter('all',this)">All</button>
        <button class="filter" onclick="window.setTournamentFilter('free',this)">Free</button>
        <button class="filter" onclick="window.setTournamentFilter('paid',this)">Paid</button>
        <button class="filter" onclick="window.setTournamentFilter('upcoming',this)">Upcoming</button>
        <button class="filter" onclick="window.setTournamentFilter('endmatch',this)">End Match</button>
        <button class="filter" onclick="window.setTournamentFilter('complete',this)">Complete</button>
        <button class="filter" onclick="window.setTournamentFilter('cancelmatch',this)">Cancel Match</button>
      </div>
      <div id="tournamentList"></div>
    </section>

    <!-- MY TOURNAMENTS / MATCHES -->
    <section id="page-matches" class="page">
      <div class="ld-top">
        <div class="section-title" style="margin:0">My Tournaments</div>
        <button class="ld-mytickets-btn" onclick="window.openPage('history')">Your Match</button>
      </div>
      <div id="matchList"></div>
    </section>

    <!-- LUCKY DRAW -->
    <section id="page-luckydraw" class="page">
      <div class="ld-top">
        <div class="section-title" style="margin:0">Lucky Draw</div>
        <button id="ldTicketsBtn" class="ld-mytickets-btn" onclick="window.openLuckyTickets()">🎟️ Your Ticket<span id="ldTicketDot" class="ld-dot hidden"></span></button>
      </div>
      <div id="ldList" class="ld-list"></div>
    </section>

    <!-- LUCKY DRAW — MY TICKETS -->
    <section id="page-luckytickets" class="page page-white">
      <div class="acct-head">
        <button class="back-btn" onclick="window.openPage('luckydraw')">←</button>
        <div>
          <div class="acct-name">Your Tickets</div>
          <div class="acct-sub">Lucky Draw entries & results</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div id="ldTicketList"></div>
    </section>

    <!-- DEPOSIT -->
    <section id="page-deposit" class="page">
  <div id="rejectionCard" class="rej-card hidden">
    <div id="rejectionRing" class="rej-ring"><i id="rejectionLeft">5</i></div>
    <div class="rej-text">
      <div id="rejectionTitle" class="rej-title">5 rejections left</div>
      <div id="rejectionSub" class="rej-sub">Your account is restricted after 5 rejected deposit requests.</div>
    </div>
  </div>

      <div class="card">
        <div class="section-title">Add Money</div>
        <div id="depositDisabledNotice" class="block-notice hidden"></div>
        <div class="notice">Minimum Deposit: <strong id="minDepositText">₹100</strong></div>
        <div id="depositPendingNotice" class="warning hidden">You have a pending deposit or withdrawal. Please wait.</div>
        <div id="depositPaymentBox">
          <div class="notice">Pay UPI: <span class="copy-line"><strong id="adminUpi">-</strong><button class="copy-mini" onclick="window.copyProfileField('adminUpi','UPI ID')">Copy</button></span></div>
          <div id="qrBox" class="hidden" style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:14px">
            <img id="qrImage" alt="QR" style="width:200px;max-width:100%;border-radius:14px">
          </div>
          <input id="depositAmount" class="form-input" type="number" min="1" placeholder="Deposit Amount">
          <input id="depositTxid" class="form-input" type="text" placeholder="UPI Transaction / Reference ID">
          <button id="depositSubmitBtn" class="form-btn" onclick="window.submitDeposit()">Submit Deposit</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="card">
        <div class="section-title">Deposit History</div>
        <div id="depositHistory"></div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <!-- WITHDRAW -->
    <section id="page-withdraw" class="page">
      <div class="card">
        <div class="section-title">Withdraw Money</div>
        <div id="withdrawDisabledNotice" class="block-notice hidden"></div>
        <div class="history-line" style="margin-bottom:14px">
          <span class="history-label">Winning Balance</span>
          <strong id="withdrawBalance">₹0.00</strong>
        </div>
        <div id="withdrawPendingNotice" class="warning hidden">You already have a pending withdrawal.</div>
        <div id="withdrawFormBox">
          <input id="withdrawAmount" class="form-input" type="number" min="1" placeholder="Withdrawal Amount">
          <input id="withdrawUpi" class="form-input" type="text" placeholder="Your UPI ID">
          <button id="withdrawSubmitBtn" class="form-btn" onclick="window.submitWithdrawal()">Request Withdrawal</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="card">
        <div class="section-title">Withdrawal History</div>
        <div id="withdrawHistory"></div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <!-- NOTIFICATIONS -->
    <section id="page-notifications" class="page">
      <div class="section-title">Notifications</div>
      <div id="notificationList"></div>
    </section>

    <!-- REFERRAL -->
    <section id="page-referral" class="page">
      <div class="section-title">Referral</div>
      <div class="ref-code-box">
        <div style="font-size:14px;opacity:.9">Your Referral Code</div>
        <div id="myReferralCode" class="ref-code">------</div>
        <button class="copy-ref" onclick="window.copyReferralCode()">Copy Code</button>
      </div>
      <div class="card">
        <div class="card-title" style="font-weight:800;margin-bottom:10px">How it works</div>
        <div style="font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;color:#475569">
          Share your code with friends.<br>
          When they register using your code and make their <b>first successful deposit</b>, both of you get <b id="referralBonusText">₹5.00</b>.
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="card">
        <div class="section-title" style="font-size:17px">Your Referrals</div>
        <div id="myReferralsList"></div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <!-- SUPPORT -->
    <section id="page-support" class="page">
      <div class="section-title">Customer Support</div>
      <div class="card">
        <div class="section-title" style="font-size:17px">Create Ticket</div>
        <div id="supportScheduleBox" class="hidden" style="padding:12px 14px;border-radius:14px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.55;margin-bottom:12px;background:#effaf3;color:#1a7a4c"></div>
        <input id="supportSubject" class="form-input" placeholder="Subject">
        <textarea id="supportMessage" class="form-input" rows="4" placeholder="Describe your issue..." style="height:auto;padding:12px 15px"></textarea>
        <button class="form-btn" onclick="window.submitSupportTicket()">Submit Ticket</button>
      </div>
      <div class="card">
        <div class="section-title" style="font-size:17px">My Tickets</div>
        <div id="supportHistory"></div>
      </div>
    </section>


    <!-- WALLET -->
    <section id="page-wallet" class="page">
      <div class="section-title">Wallet</div>
      <div class="wallet-hero atm-card">
        <div>
          <div class="wallet-hero-top"><div class="wallet-hero-title">TMGame Wallet</div><div class="wallet-chip">Secure</div></div>
          <div class="wallet-split"><div class="wallet-cell"><div class="wc-label"><span class="wc-dot"></span>Available Balance</div><div id="walletPageAvailable" class="wc-value">₹0.00</div><div class="wc-hint">Available for transfers</div></div><div class="wallet-divider"></div><div class="wallet-cell win"><div class="wc-label"><span class="wc-dot"></span>Winning Balance</div><div id="walletPageWinning" class="wc-value">₹0.00</div><div class="wc-hint">Available for withdrawal</div></div></div>
        </div>
        <div class="wallet-account" id="walletAccountBlock" data-transfer-only>
          <div class="wallet-account-label">TMGame Account Number</div>
          <div class="wallet-account-row">
            <button class="wallet-account-number" id="walletAccountNumber" type="button" data-full-value="" aria-label="Reveal TMGame account number" onclick="window.toggleWalletAccount()">•••• •••• ••</button>
            <button class="wallet-icon-btn" id="walletRevealBtn" type="button" aria-label="Show account number" title="Show account number" onclick="window.toggleWalletAccount()">◉</button>
            <button class="wallet-icon-btn" type="button" aria-label="Copy account number" title="Copy account number" onclick="window.copyWalletAccount()">⧉</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="wallet-action-grid"><button class="wallet-action primary" onclick="window.openPage('deposit')"><span>＋</span><b>Deposit</b></button><button class="wallet-action" onclick="window.openPage('withdraw')"><span>↗</span><b>Withdrawal</b></button></div>
      <button class="transfer-launch" id="transferLaunchBtn" data-transfer-only onclick="window.openTransferPanel()"><span class="transfer-launch-icon">⇄</span><span><b>TMGame Transfer Wallet</b><small>Send money with a 10-digit account number</small></span><span>›</span></button>
      <div id="standardWalletHistory" class="card wallet-history-card">
        <div class="wallet-history-tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Wallet history"><button id="depositHistoryTab" class="wallet-history-tab active" type="button" role="tab" aria-selected="true" onclick="window.showWalletHistory('deposit')">Deposit History</button><button id="withdrawHistoryTab" class="wallet-history-tab" type="button" role="tab" aria-selected="false" onclick="window.showWalletHistory('withdraw')">Withdrawal History</button></div>
        <div id="walletDepositPanel" class="wallet-history-panel" role="tabpanel"><div id="walletDepositHistory"></div></div>
        <div id="walletWithdrawPanel" class="wallet-history-panel hidden" role="tabpanel"><div id="walletWithdrawHistory"></div></div>
      </div>
      <div id="transferWalletHistory" class="card wallet-history-card hidden"><div class="wallet-transaction-title"><span class="wallet-history-icon dep">⇄</span><div class="section-title" style="font-size:17px;margin:0">Transaction History</div></div><div id="transferHistory"></div></div>
    </section>

   <!-- PROFILE / MENU -->
<section id="page-profile" class="page">
  <div id="restrictNotice" class="restrict-note hidden">
    🔒 Your account is restricted because 5 deposit requests were rejected. Tournaments, deposits and withdrawals are locked. Please contact Customer Support.
  </div>
  <div class="menu-label">Menu</div>
  <div class="menu-card">
    <button class="menu-item" data-menu-option="profile" onclick="window.openPage('account')"><span class="mi-icon">👤</span><span>Profile</span><span class="mi-arrow">›</span></button>
    <button class="menu-item" data-menu-option="refer" onclick="window.openPage('referral')"><span class="mi-icon">🎁</span><span>Refer a Friend</span><span class="mi-arrow">›</span></button>
    <button class="menu-item hidden" data-menu-option="leaderboard" id="leaderboardMenuItem" onclick="window.openPage('leaderboard')"><span class="mi-icon">🏆</span><span>Leaderboard</span><span class="mi-arrow">›</span></button>
    <button class="menu-item" data-menu-option="telegram" id="telegramMenuItem" onclick="window.openTelegram()"><span class="mi-icon" id="telegramMenuIcon"><span class="logo-fallback">T</span></span><span>Telegram</span><span class="mi-arrow">›</span></button>
    <button class="menu-item" data-menu-option="support" onclick="window.openPage('support')"><span class="mi-icon" id="supportMenuIcon"><span class="logo-fallback">S</span></span><span>Customer Support</span><span class="mi-arrow">›</span></button>
    <button class="menu-item hidden" data-menu-option="about" id="aboutMenuItem" onclick="window.openPage('about')"><span class="mi-icon">ⓘ</span><span id="aboutMenuTitle">About</span><span class="mi-arrow">›</span></button>
  </div>
  <div class="menu-label">Activity</div><div class="menu-card"><button class="menu-item" onclick="window.openPage('bank')"><span class="mi-icon">🏦</span><span>TMGame Bank</span><span class="mi-arrow">›</span></button><button class="menu-item" onclick="window.openPage('history')"><span class="mi-icon">🏆</span><span>Tournament History</span><span class="mi-arrow">›</span></button><button class="menu-item" onclick="window.openPage('luckytickets')"><span class="mi-icon">🎟️</span><span>Lucky Draw History</span><span class="mi-arrow">›</span></button><div id="socialMenuList"></div></div>

</section>


<!-- TMGAME BANK -->
<section id="page-bank" class="page page-white">
  <div class="bank-page-head"><button class="back-btn" onclick="window.openPage('profile')">←</button><div class="bank-welcome"><small>TMGame Bank</small><b id="bankUserName">User</b></div></div>
  <div class="tm-bank-card">
    <div class="tm-bank-card-top"><div class="tm-bank-card-brand">TMGAME BANK</div><div id="bankActiveState" class="tm-bank-active">ACTIVE</div></div>
    <div class="tm-bank-balance-label">Available Balance</div><div id="bankAvailableBalance" class="tm-bank-balance">₹0.00</div>
    <div class="tm-bank-card-bottom"><div class="tm-bank-account"><small>Account Number</small><b id="bankAccountNumber">•••• •••• ••</b></div><div class="tm-bank-wordmark">TMGame Bank</div></div>
  </div>
  <div class="tm-bank-actions">
    <button class="tm-bank-action primary" onclick="window.openTransferPanel()"><span>⇄</span>Transfer</button>
    <button class="tm-bank-action" onclick="window.openBankHistory()"><span>↺</span>Bank History</button>
    <button class="tm-bank-action" onclick="window.openPage('banknotifications')"><span>♧</span>Notifications</button>
  </div>
  <div class="card tm-total-history"><div class="tm-total-history-head"><div class="section-title" style="font-size:17px;margin:0">Total Transaction History</div><small>Latest 5</small></div><div id="bankTotalHistory"></div></div>
</section>

<!-- BANK NOTIFICATIONS -->
<section id="page-banknotifications" class="page page-white bank-notification-page">
  <div class="acct-head bank-note-back"><button class="back-btn" onclick="window.openPage('bank')">←</button><div><div class="acct-name">Notifications</div><div class="acct-sub">Messages from TMGame Bank</div></div></div>
  <div id="bankNotificationList"></div>
</section>

<!-- ABOUT / APP USAGE GUIDES -->
<section id="page-about" class="page page-white">
  <div class="acct-head">
    <button class="back-btn" onclick="window.openPage('profile')">←</button>
    <div>
      <div class="section-title" id="aboutPageTitle" style="margin:0">About</div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="card" style="padding:0;overflow:hidden">
    <div id="aboutGuideList"></div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- YOUR PROFILE DETAILS -->
<section id="page-account" class="page page-white">
  <div class="acct-head">
    <button class="back-btn" onclick="window.openPage('profile')">←</button>
    <div>
      <div id="acctName" class="acct-name">-</div>
      <div class="acct-sub">Personal account</div>
    </div>
    <div id="profileAvatar" class="profile-avatar sm">U</div>
  </div>
  <div class="card">
    <div class="section-title">Your Profile</div>
    <div class="profile-row"><span class="profile-label">Name</span><span id="profileName" class="profile-value">-</span></div>
    <div class="profile-row"><span class="profile-label">Email</span><span class="profile-copy-wrap"><span id="profileEmail" class="profile-value">-</span><button class="copy-mini" onclick="window.copyProfileField('profileEmail','Email')">Copy</button></span></div>
    <div class="profile-row uid-row"><span class="profile-label">User ID</span><span class="profile-copy-wrap uid-wrap"><span id="profileUid" class="profile-value uid-value revealed" title="Tap to copy" onclick="window.copyProfileField('profileUid','User ID')">-</span><span class="uid-actions"><button id="uidCopyBtn" class="copy-mini" onclick="window.copyProfileField('profileUid','User ID')">Copy</button></span></span></div>
    <div class="profile-row" id="profileAccountRow" data-transfer-only><span class="profile-label">TMGame Account No.</span><span class="profile-copy-wrap"><span id="profileAccountNo" class="profile-value account-number">----------</span><button class="copy-mini" onclick="window.copyProfileField('profileAccountNo','Account Number')">Copy</button></span></div>
    <div class="profile-row"><span class="profile-label">Phone</span><span id="profilePhone" class="profile-value">-</span></div>
    <div class="profile-row"><span class="profile-label">Available Balance</span><span id="profileWallet" class="profile-value">₹0.00</span></div>
    <div class="profile-row"><span class="profile-label">Winning Balance</span><span id="profileWinning" class="profile-value">₹0.00</span></div>
    <div class="profile-row"><span class="profile-label">Account Status</span><span id="profileStatus" class="profile-value">Active</span></div>
    <div class="profile-row"><span class="profile-label">TMGame Bank Status</span><span id="profileBankStatus" class="profile-value">Active</span></div>
    <div class="profile-row"><span class="profile-label">Customer Care Status</span><span id="profileSupportStatus" class="profile-value">Active</span></div>
    <div class="profile-row"><span class="profile-label">Referral Code</span><span id="profileRefCode" class="profile-value">-</span></div>
  </div>
  <div class="card">
    <button class="form-btn" style="background:#f5f2f2" onclick="window.logoutUser()">Logout</button>

/* Real background data refresh performed while the loading screen is visible. */
async function runBackgroundSync(){

function showSplash(){
  const splash = document.getElementById("splashScreen");
  if(!splash) return;
  splashShownAt = Date.now();
  splash.classList.remove("hidden");
  // force a frame so the fade-in transition actually plays
  requestAnimationFrame(() => splash.classList.remove("splash-hide"));
  // kick off a genuine data refresh behind the loading visual
  splashSyncPromise = runBackgroundSync();
}

function hideSplash(){
  if(!navigator.onLine) return;
  const splash = document.getElementById("splashScreen");
  if(!splash || splash.classList.contains("hidden")) return;
  const pending = splashSyncPromise || Promise.resolve();
  splashSyncPromise = null;
  Promise.resolve(pending).catch(()=>{}).then(() => {
    const wait = Math.max(0, SPLASH_MIN_MS - (Date.now() - splashShownAt));
    window.setTimeout(() => {
      splash.classList.add("splash-hide");
      window.setTimeout(() => splash.classList.add("hidden"), 520);
    }, wait);
  });
}

      measurementId: String(d.measurementId || "")
    };
    const current = JSON.stringify(resolveFirebaseConfig());
    if(JSON.stringify(Object.assign({}, defaultFirebaseConfig, next)) === current) return;

}

/* ========== LEADERBOARD RESET + BONUS COUNTDOWN ========== */
function lbToMillis(t){
  if(!t) return 0;
  if(typeof t === "number") return t;
  if(typeof t.toMillis === "function") return t.toMillis();
  if(t.seconds) return Number(t.seconds) * 1000;
  const n = new Date(t).getTime();
  return isNaN(n) ? 0 : n;
}
/* Reset moment = when admin switched the leaderboard back ON */
function lbResetAt(){
  let local = 0;
  try{ local = Number(localStorage.getItem("tmLbResetAt") || 0) || 0; }catch(e){}
  return Math.max(Number(settings.leaderboardResetAt || 0), local);
}
function lbTrackToggle(enabled){
  let stored = null;
  try{ stored = localStorage.getItem("tmLbEnabledState"); }catch(e){}
  const prev = stored === null ? null : stored === "1";
  if(prev === false && enabled === true){
    try{ localStorage.setItem("tmLbResetAt", String(Date.now())); }catch(e){}
  }
  try{ localStorage.setItem("tmLbEnabledState", enabled ? "1" : "0"); }catch(e){}
}
function lbCountReferrals(users){
  const reset = lbResetAt();
  const counts = {};
  users.forEach(u => {
    if(!(u.referredBy && u.firstDepositRewarded)) return;
    if(reset){
      const t = lbToMillis(u.firstDepositRewardedAt || u.firstDepositAt || u.createdAt);
      if(t && t < reset) return;
    }
    counts[u.referredBy] = (counts[u.referredBy] || 0) + 1;
  });
  return counts;
}
function lbWeekStart(now){
  const d = new Date(now.getTime());
  d.setHours(0,0,0,0);
  const day = d.getDay();
  d.setDate(d.getDate() - (day === 0 ? 6 : day - 1));
  return d;
}
function lbMonthStart(now){
  return new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), 1, 0, 0, 0, 0);
}
const LB_DAY_NAMES = ["Sunday","Monday","Tuesday","Wednesday","Thursday","Friday","Saturday"];
function lbWeeklyDay(){
  const n = Number(settings.weeklyBonusDay);
  return (isNaN(n) || n < 0 || n > 6) ? 0 : n;
}
function lbMonthlyDay(){
  const v = settings.monthlyBonusDay;
  if(v == null || v === "last") return "last";
  const n = Number(v);
  if(isNaN(n) || n < 1 || n > 31) return "last";
  return n;
}
/* Next occurrence of the admin-selected weekly bonus day */
function lbNextWeekly(now){
  const target = lbWeeklyDay();
  const d = new Date(now.getTime());
  d.setHours(0,0,0,0);
  let diff = (target - d.getDay() + 7) % 7;
  if(diff === 0) diff = 7;
  d.setDate(d.getDate() + diff);
  return d;
}
/* Next occurrence of the admin-selected monthly bonus date (or last day of month) */
function lbNextMonthly(now){
  const day = lbMonthlyDay();
  const build = (year, monthIndex) => {
    const lastDate = new Date(year, monthIndex + 1, 0).getDate();
    const dayOfMonth = day === "last" ? lastDate : Math.min(day, lastDate);
    return new Date(year, monthIndex, dayOfMonth, 0, 0, 0, 0);
  };
  let target = build(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth());
  if(now.getTime() >= target.getTime()) target = build(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() + 1);
  return target;
}
function lbFormatLeft(ms){
  if(ms < 0) ms = 0;
  const total = Math.floor(ms / 1000);
  const d = Math.floor(total / 86400);
  const h = Math.floor((total % 86400) / 3600);
  const m = Math.floor((total % 3600) / 60);
  const s = total % 60;
  const p = n => String(n).padStart(2,"0");
  return (d > 0 ? d + "d " : "") + p(h) + "h " + p(m) + "m " + p(s) + "s";
}
let lbCountdownTimer = null;
function lbRenderCountdown(){
  const wVal = document.getElementById("lbWeeklyCountdown");
  const mVal = document.getElementById("lbMonthlyCountdown");
  const wCard = document.getElementById("lbWeeklyTimer");
  const mCard = document.getElementById("lbMonthlyTimer");
  const wSub = document.getElementById("lbWeeklySub");
  const mSub = document.getElementById("lbMonthlySub");
  const note = document.getElementById("lbResetNote");
  if(!wVal || !mVal) return;

  if(!settings.leaderboardEnabled){
    wCard.classList.add("paused");
    mCard.classList.add("paused");
    wVal.textContent = "Paused";
    mVal.textContent = "Paused";
    wSub.textContent = "Bonuses are off";
    mSub.textContent = "Bonuses are off";
    if(note) note.classList.add("hidden");
    return;
  }
  wCard.classList.remove("paused");
  mCard.classList.remove("paused");

  const now = new Date();
  const w = lbNextWeekly(now);
  const m = lbNextMonthly(now);
  const fmt = { day:"numeric", month:"short" };
  wVal.textContent = lbFormatLeft(w.getTime() - now.getTime());
  mVal.textContent = lbFormatLeft(m.getTime() - now.getTime());
  wSub.textContent = LB_DAY_NAMES[lbWeeklyDay()] + ", " + w.toLocaleDateString("en-IN", fmt);
  mSub.textContent = (lbMonthlyDay() === "last" ? "Last day, " : "") + m.toLocaleDateString("en-IN", fmt);

  if(note){
    const reset = lbResetAt();
    const fresh = reset && (reset > lbWeekStart(now).getTime() || reset > lbMonthStart(now).getTime());
    if(fresh){
      note.textContent = "Leaderboard was reset on " + new Date(reset).toLocaleDateString("en-IN", { day:"numeric", month:"short" }) + ". Counting and bonuses start fresh from the next cycle.";
      note.classList.remove("hidden");
    }else note.classList.add("hidden");
  }
}
function startLbCountdown(){
  lbRenderCountdown();
  if(lbCountdownTimer) clearInterval(lbCountdownTimer);
  lbCountdownTimer = setInterval(lbRenderCountdown, 1000);
}

function tmMs(v){ if(!v) return 0; const d = new Date(v); const n = d.getTime(); return isNaN(n) ? 0 : n; }
function tmLeft(ms){
  let s = Math.max(0, Math.floor(ms/1000));
  const d = Math.floor(s/86400); s -= d*86400;
  const h = Math.floor(s/3600); s -= h*3600;
  const m = Math.floor(s/60); s -= m*60;
  const pad = n => String(n).padStart(2,"0");
  return (d > 0 ? d + "d " : "") + pad(h) + ":" + pad(m) + ":" + pad(s);
}
function tmTickCountdowns(){
  document.querySelectorAll("[data-cd][data-t]").forEach(el => {
    const target = Number(el.dataset.t||0);
    const diff = target - Date.now();
    if(!target){ el.textContent = "-"; return; }
    if(diff > 0){ el.textContent = tmLeft(diff); return; }
    el.textContent = "00:00:00";
    const card = el.closest(".tournament-card");
    if(!card) return;
    if(el.dataset.cd === "end"){
      const box = el.closest(".tm-cd");
      if(box && !box.classList.contains("hide")){
        box.classList.add("hide");
        setTimeout(() => box.remove(), 400);
      }
      card.classList.add("deadline-over");
      const btn = card.querySelector(".join-btn:not(.disabled)");
      if(btn){
        btn.classList.add("disabled");
        btn.disabled = true;
        btn.removeAttribute("onclick");
        btn.style.background = "#64748b";
        btn.style.color = "#fff";
        btn.textContent = "Ending Match";
      }
    } else if(el.dataset.cd === "start"){
      const box = el.closest(".tm-cd");
      if(box){ box.classList.add("hide"); setTimeout(() => box.remove(), 400); }
    }
  });
}
setInterval(tmTickCountdowns, 1000);

function getTournamentState(t){
  const now = Date.now();
  const status = String(t.status || "Upcoming");
  if(["cancel match","cancelled","canceled"].includes(status.toLowerCase().trim())) return "cancelmatch";
  if(status === "Completed") return "complete";
  const startTime = t.registrationEnd ? new Date(t.registrationEnd).getTime() : 0;
  const endTime = t.matchEnding ? new Date(t.matchEnding).getTime() : 0;
  if(endTime && !isNaN(endTime) && now >= endTime) return "endmatch";
  if(startTime && !isNaN(startTime) && now < startTime) return "upcoming";
  return "open"; // joinable
}

/* Closed / turned-OFF matches must never appear in the User Panel tournament list. */
function isTournamentVisible(t){
  const status = String(t.status || "").toLowerCase().trim();
  const matchStatus = String(t.matchStatus || "").toLowerCase().trim();
  // A cancelled match must remain visible even if cancellation also turns the match off.
  if(status === "cancel match" || status === "cancelled" || status === "canceled") return true;
  // Admin "Match OFF (Closed)" toggle -> completely hidden from the User Panel
  if(t.matchOpen === false || t.matchOpen === "false") return false;
  // Closed / turned-OFF / inactive matches never render
  if(status === "closed" || status === "match closed" || status === "off" || status === "inactive") return false;
  if(matchStatus === "closed" || matchStatus === "off" || matchStatus === "inactive") return false;
  if(t.active === false || t.isActive === false || t.matchOn === false || t.isMatchOn === false) return false;
  // Automatic hiding: once the admin "Close Match Schedule" time is reached, the card disappears
  const closeAt = t.matchTime ? new Date(t.matchTime).getTime() : 0;
  if(closeAt && !isNaN(closeAt) && Date.now() >= closeAt) return false;
  return true;
}

/* Re-render the tournament lists as soon as any Close Match Schedule time passes. */
let __closeWatchSeen = "";
function watchCloseSchedules(){
  try{
    if(!Array.isArray(tournaments) || !tournaments.length) return;
    const hidden = tournaments.filter(t => !isTournamentVisible(t)).map(t => t.id).sort().join(",");
    if(hidden !== __closeWatchSeen){
      __closeWatchSeen = hidden;
      renderTournaments();
    }
  }catch(e){}
}
setInterval(watchCloseSchedules, 1000);

let categories = readListCache("tmgameCategoryCache"), currentCategoryId = null, categoryTypeFilter = "all", categoriesLoading = categories.length === 0, tournamentsLoading = tournaments.length === 0;
let categoriesUnsubscribe = null, tournamentsUnsubscribe = null;

async function loadCategories(){
  categoriesLoading = true;
  renderCategories();
  try{
    const nextCategories = [];
    const snap = await getDocs(collection(db,"gameCategories"));
    snap.forEach(d => nextCategories.push({id:d.id, ...d.data()}));
    categories = nextCategories;
    writeListCache("tmgameCategoryCache",categories);
  }catch(e){ console.error("Load Categories Error:", e); }
  categoriesLoading = false;
  renderCategories();
}

function normalizedCategoryValue(value){
  if(value && typeof value === "object") value = value.id || value.categoryId || value.name || value.title || "";
  return String(value || "").trim().toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "");
}
function catTournaments(id){
  const category = categories.find(c => String(c.id) === String(id));
  const categoryKeys = [id, category?.id, category?.name, category?.title, category?.gameName]
    .map(normalizedCategoryValue).filter(Boolean);
  return tournaments.filter(t => {
    const tournamentKeys = [
      t.categoryId, t.gameCategoryId, t.category, t.categoryName,
      t.gameId, t.gameName, t.game, t.gameCategory
    ].map(normalizedCategoryValue).filter(Boolean);
    return isTournamentVisible(t) && categoryKeys.some(key => tournamentKeys.includes(key));
  });
}

function renderCategories(){
  const box = document.getElementById("categorySlider");
  const sec = document.getElementById("categorySection");
  if(!box || !sec) return;
  sec.classList.remove("hidden");
  if(!categories.length){
    box.innerHTML = (categoriesLoading || tournamentsLoading) ? "" : `<div class="home-empty">${emptyHTML("🏆","No Tournament")}</div>`;
    return;
  }
  box.innerHTML = categories.map(c => {
    const hasMatches = catTournaments(c.id).length > 0;
    return `<div class="cat-card" onclick="window.openCategory('${c.id}')">
      <div class="cat-thumb">${c.imageUrl ? `<img src="${esc(c.imageUrl)}" alt="${esc(c.name||"Category")}">` : `<div class="cat-fallback">\u{1F3AE}</div>`}</div>
      <div class="cat-meta">
        <span class="cat-dot" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        <div class="cat-name">${esc(c.name||"Category")}</div>
        <span class="cat-count${catTournaments(c.id).length ? "" : " zero"}" title="Available tournaments">${catTournaments(c.id).length}</span>
      </div>
    </div>`;
  }).join("");
}

  categoryTypeFilter = "all";

  const c = categories.find(x => x.id === id);

};

window.setCategoryTypeFilter = function(type, btn){
  categoryTypeFilter = type;
  document.querySelectorAll("[data-category-type]").forEach(el => el.classList.remove("active"));
  btn.classList.add("active");
  renderCategoryTournaments();
};

function renderCategoryTournaments(){
  const box = document.getElementById("categoryTournamentList");
  if(!box) return;
  const list = catTournaments(currentCategoryId).filter(t => {
    if(categoryTypeFilter === "all") return true;
    return String(t.entryType||"Free").toLowerCase() === categoryTypeFilter;
  });
  box.innerHTML = list.length ? list.map(t => tournamentHTML(t)).join("") : emptyHTML("\u{1F3C6}",`No ${categoryTypeFilter === "all" ? "" : categoryTypeFilter + " "}tournaments available`);
}

async function loadTournaments(){
  tournamentsLoading = true;
  renderCategories();
  try {
    const nextTournaments = [];
    const snap = await getDocs(collection(db,"tournaments"));
    snap.forEach(d => nextTournaments.push({id:d.id, ...d.data()}));
    tournaments = nextTournaments;
    tournaments.sort((a,b) => new Date(a.registrationEnd || a.matchTime || 0) - new Date(b.registrationEnd || b.matchTime || 0));
    writeListCache("tmgameTournamentCache",tournaments);
  } catch(e) {
    console.error("Load Tournaments Error:", e);
  } finally {
    tournamentsLoading = false;
  }
  renderTournaments();
  renderCategories();
}

function stopCompetitionListeners(){
  if(categoriesUnsubscribe){ try{ categoriesUnsubscribe(); }catch(e){} categoriesUnsubscribe = null; }
  if(tournamentsUnsubscribe){ try{ tournamentsUnsubscribe(); }catch(e){} tournamentsUnsubscribe = null; }
}

function startCompetitionListeners(){
  stopCompetitionListeners();
  categoriesUnsubscribe = onSnapshot(collection(db,"gameCategories"), snap => {
    categories = snap.docs.map(d => ({id:d.id, ...d.data()}));
    writeListCache("tmgameCategoryCache",categories);
    categoriesLoading = false;
    renderCategories();
    if(currentCategoryId) renderCategoryTournaments();
  }, e => console.error("Categories live sync error:", e));
  tournamentsUnsubscribe = onSnapshot(collection(db,"tournaments"), snap => {
    tournaments = snap.docs.map(d => ({id:d.id, ...d.data()}));
    tournaments.sort((a,b) => new Date(a.registrationEnd || a.matchTime || 0) - new Date(b.registrationEnd || b.matchTime || 0));
    writeListCache("tmgameTournamentCache",tournaments);
    tournamentsLoading = false;
    renderTournaments();
    renderCategories();
    if(currentCategoryId) renderCategoryTournaments();
  }, e => console.error("Tournaments live sync error:", e));
}

window.setTournamentFilter = function(f, btn){
  tournamentFilter = f;
  document.querySelectorAll(".filter").forEach(el => el.classList.remove("active"));
  btn.classList.add("active");
  renderTournaments();
};

function renderTournaments(){
  const filtered = tournaments.filter(t => {
    if(!isTournamentVisible(t)) return false;
    const type = String(t.entryType||"Free").toLowerCase();
    const state = getTournamentState(t);
    if(tournamentFilter === "free") return type === "free";
    if(tournamentFilter === "paid") return type === "paid";
    if(tournamentFilter === "upcoming") return state === "upcoming" || (state === "open" && String(t.status||"Upcoming") === "Upcoming");
    if(tournamentFilter === "endmatch") return state === "endmatch";
    if(tournamentFilter === "complete") return state === "complete";
    if(tournamentFilter === "cancelmatch") return state === "cancelmatch";
    return true;
  });
  document.getElementById("tournamentList").innerHTML = filtered.length ? filtered.map(t => tournamentHTML(t)).join("") : emptyHTML("🏆","No Tournament");
  renderCategories();
  if(currentCategoryId) renderCategoryTournaments();
}

function tournamentHTML(t){
  const type = String(t.entryType||"Free").toLowerCase();
  const joined = Number(t.joinedCount || Object.keys(t.takenSeats||{}).length || 0);
  const slots = Number(t.totalSlots || 0);
  const full = slots > 0 && joined >= slots;
  const blocked = isUserBlocked() || currentUserData?.canJoinTournaments === false;
  const pendingW = hasPendingWithdrawal || hasPendingDeposit;
  const state = getTournamentState(t);

  let btn = "";
  if(state === "cancelmatch") btn = `<button class="join-btn disabled" disabled style="background:#ef4444;color:#fff">Cancel Match</button>`;
  else if(state === "complete") btn = `<button class="join-btn disabled" disabled style="background:#0f172a;color:#fff">Completed</button>`;
  else if(state === "endmatch") btn = `<button class="join-btn disabled" disabled style="background:#64748b;color:#fff">Ending Match</button>`;
  else if(state === "upcoming") btn = `<button class="join-btn disabled" disabled>Upcoming</button>`;
  else if(blocked) btn = `<button class="join-btn disabled" disabled>🔒 Restricted</button>`;
  else if(pendingW) btn = `<button class="join-btn disabled" disabled>⏳ ${hasPendingDeposit && !hasPendingWithdrawal ? "Deposit" : "Withdrawal"} Pending</button>`;
  else if(full) btn = `<button class="join-btn disabled" disabled>Slots Full</button>`;
  else btn = `<button class="join-btn" onclick="window.openTournament('${t.id}')">View & Join</button>`;

  const startMs = tmMs(t.registrationEnd);
  const endMs = tmMs(t.matchEnding);
  const now = Date.now();
  let cdHTML = "";
  if(state === "cancelmatch"){
    cdHTML = `<div class="tm-cancel-tag">\u274C Match Cancelled \u2013 Entry fee refunded to wallet.</div>`;
  } else if(state !== "complete"){
    let inner = "";
    if(startMs && now < startMs){
      inner += `<div class="tm-cd start"><span>Starts in</span><i data-cd="start" data-t="${startMs}">--</i></div>`;
    }
    if(endMs && now < endMs && (!startMs || now >= startMs)){
      inner += `<div class="tm-cd end"><span>Join closes in</span><i data-cd="end" data-t="${endMs}">--</i></div>`;
    }
    if(inner) cdHTML = `<div class="tm-cd-wrap">${inner}</div>`;
  }

  let customOpts = "";
  if(t.customOption1 || t.customOption2){
    customOpts = `<div style="margin:8px 0 4px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px">`;
    if(t.customOption1) customOpts += `<span style="background:#e0e7ff;color:#3730a3;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:20px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700">${esc(t.customOption1)}</span>`;
    if(t.customOption2) customOpts += `<span style="background:#e0e7ff;color:#3730a3;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:20px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700">${esc(t.customOption2)}</span>`;
    customOpts += `</div>`;
  }

  return `<div class="tournament-card${state === "cancelmatch" ? " cancelled-card" : ""}">
    ${state === "cancelmatch" ? `<div class="cancel-seal" aria-label="Match cancelled">MATCH CANCELLED</div>` : ""}
    ${t.imageUrl ? `<img class="tournament-banner" src="${esc(t.imageUrl)}" onerror="this.style.display='none'">` : ""}
    <div class="tournament-body">
      <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:8px">
        <div class="tournament-name">${esc(t.name||"Tournament")}</div>
        <div class="badge ${type==="paid"?"badge-paid":"badge-free"}">${type==="paid"?"PAID":"FREE"}</div>
      </div>
      <div style="margin-top:4px;color:#64748b;font-size:13px">${esc(t.gameName||t.game||"-")}</div>
      <div class="info-grid">
        <div class="info-box"><div class="info-label">Mode</div><div class="info-value">${esc(t.mode||"-")}</div></div>
        <div class="info-box"><div class="info-label">Entry</div><div class="info-value">${type==="paid"?money(t.entryFee):"Free"}</div></div>
        <div class="info-box"><div class="info-label">Prize</div><div class="info-value">${money(t.prize)}</div></div>
        <div class="info-box"><div class="info-label">Slots</div><div class="info-value">${joined}/${slots||"∞"}</div></div>
      </div>
      ${customOpts}
       <div class="schedule-line">
         <span>Starting Match Schedule</span><b>${formatDate(t.registrationEnd)}</b>
         <span>Match Ending</span><b>${formatDate(t.matchEnding)}</b>
       </div>
       ${cdHTML}
      ${btn}
    </div>
  </div>`;
}

window.confirmJoinTournament = async function(){
  if(isUserBlocked()){ showToast("Your account is blocked"); return; }
  const t = tournaments.find(x => x.id === selectedTournamentId);
  if(!t) return;
  const state = getTournamentState(t);
  if(state !== "open"){
    showToast("This match is no longer open for joining.");
    return;
  }
  if(hasPendingWithdrawal || hasPendingDeposit){
    showToast(hasPendingDeposit && !hasPendingWithdrawal ? "Cannot join while a deposit is pending" : "Cannot join while a withdrawal is pending");
    return;
  }
  const type = String(t.entryType||"Free").toLowerCase();
  const fee = type === "paid" ? Number(t.entryFee||0) : 0;
  const seat = selectedSeat;
  const gamingId = (document.getElementById("joinGamingId")?.value || "").trim();

  if(!gamingId){
    showToast("Please enter your In-Game ID / Username");
    return;
  }

  const confirmBtn = document.getElementById("confirmJoinBtn");
  if(!confirmBtn || confirmBtn.disabled) return;
  confirmBtn.disabled = true;
  confirmBtn.textContent = "Joining...";
  try{
    await runTransaction(db, async (transaction) => {
      const userRef = doc(db,"users", currentUser.uid);
      const tRef = doc(db,"tournaments", selectedTournamentId);
      const userSnap = await transaction.get(userRef);
      const tSnap = await transaction.get(tRef);
      if(!userSnap.exists() || !tSnap.exists()) throw new Error("Data not found");

      const user = userSnap.data();
      const tourney = tSnap.data();
      if(user.isBlocked) throw new Error("Account blocked");
      if(user.canJoinTournaments === false) throw new Error("Joining restricted");

      const bal = Number(user.walletBalance||0);
      if(fee > 0 && bal < fee) throw new Error("Insufficient balance");

      const taken = tourney.takenSeats || {};
      if(seat && taken[String(seat)]) throw new Error("Seat already taken");

      const newBalance = bal - fee;
      const newTaken = {...taken};
      if(seat) newTaken[String(seat)] = currentUser.uid;

      const partRef = doc(collection(db,"tournamentParticipants"));
      transaction.set(partRef, {
        tournamentId: selectedTournamentId,
        userId: currentUser.uid,
        userEmail: currentUser.email || "",
        userName: user.name || "User",
        gamingId: gamingId,
        entryFee: fee,
        seatNumber: seat || null,
        status: "joined",
        joinedAt: serverTimestamp()
      });

      transaction.update(tRef, {
        takenSeats: newTaken,
        joinedCount: Number(tourney.joinedCount||0) + 1
      });

      if(fee > 0){
        transaction.update(userRef, { walletBalance: newBalance });
      }
    });

    if(fee > 0){
      await addDoc(collection(db,"walletTransactions"), {
        userId: currentUser.uid,
        type: "tournament_entry",
        amount: -fee,
        reason: `Joined ${t.name}`,
        createdAt: serverTimestamp()
      });
    }

    await pushUserNotif("Tournament joined", `You have successfully joined ${t.name || "the tournament"}. Room details will be shared before the match starts.`);
    closeJoinConfirm();
    closeTournamentModal();
    showActionReceipt("Tournament joined", "Your entry is confirmed.", [
      ["Tournament", t.name || "Tournament"], ["Game ID", gamingId], ["Seat", seat || "Auto"], ["Entry fee", money(fee)], ["Status", "Joined"]
    ]);
    await loadUser();
    await loadTournaments();
    await loadMatches();
  }catch(e){
    console.error(e);
    showToast(e.message || "Failed to join");
  }finally{
    if(confirmBtn){ confirmBtn.disabled = false; confirmBtn.textContent = "Confirm Join"; }
  }
};

/* ========== COUNTDOWN (ROOM REVEAL) ========== */
function countdownHTML(revealAt){
  if(!revealAt || isNaN(revealAt)){
    return `<div class="notice" style="margin-top:10px">Room details will be available later</div>`;
  }
  return `<div class="countdown-box" data-reveal="${revealAt}">
    <div class="cd-label">🔒 Room ID & Password unlock in</div>
    <div class="cd-timer">
      <div class="cd-unit"><div class="cd-num" data-cd="d">00</div><div class="cd-cap">Days</div></div>
      <div class="cd-unit"><div class="cd-num" data-cd="h">00</div><div class="cd-cap">Hours</div></div>
      <div class="cd-unit"><div class="cd-num" data-cd="m">00</div><div class="cd-cap">Mins</div></div>
      <div class="cd-unit"><div class="cd-num" data-cd="s">00</div><div class="cd-cap">Secs</div></div>
    </div>
  </div>`;
}

let countdownTimer = null;
function startCountdowns(){
  if(countdownTimer){ clearTimeout(countdownTimer); countdownTimer = null; }
  const loop = () => {
    tickCountdowns();
    // align every tick to the real second boundary so the timer never lags or skips
    countdownTimer = setTimeout(loop, 1000 - (Date.now() % 1000));
  };
  loop();
}
function tickCountdowns(){
  const boxes = document.querySelectorAll(".countdown-box[data-reveal]");
  if(!boxes.length) return;
  const now = Date.now();
  let expired = false;
  const pad = n => String(n).padStart(2,"0");
  boxes.forEach(box => {
    const diff = Number(box.dataset.reveal) - now;
    if(diff <= 0){
      expired = true;
      box.innerHTML = `<div class="cd-label">🔓 Unlocking room details…</div>`;
      box.removeAttribute("data-reveal");
      return;
    }
    const sec = Math.ceil(diff/1000);
    const set = (k,v) => {
      const el = box.querySelector(`[data-cd="${k}"]`);
      if(!el) return;
      const txt = pad(v);
      if(el.textContent !== txt) el.textContent = txt; // only touch the DOM when the digit changes
    };
    set("d", Math.floor(sec/86400));
    set("h", Math.floor(sec%86400/3600));
    set("m", Math.floor(sec%3600/60));
    set("s", sec%60);
  });
  if(expired) setTimeout(() => loadMatches(), 1500);
}

function renderHistory(){
  const box = document.getElementById("historyList");
  if(!box) return;
  const list = historyItems.filter(p => {
    const r = String(p.result||"").toUpperCase();
    if(historyFilter === "all") return true;
    if(historyFilter === "win") return r === "WIN";
    if(historyFilter === "loss") return r === "LOSS";
    if(historyFilter === "refund"){
      const t = tournaments.find(x => x.id === p.tournamentId) || {};
      return r === "REFUND" || r === "REFUNDED" || getTournamentState(t) === "cancelmatch" || ["CANCELLED","CANCELED","CANCEL MATCH"].includes(String(p.status||"").toUpperCase()) || ["CANCELLED","CANCELED","CANCEL MATCH"].includes(String(p.result||"").toUpperCase()) || p.cancelled === true;
    }
    return true;
  });
  if(!list.length){ box.innerHTML = emptyHTML("🏆","No tournament history yet"); return; }

  box.innerHTML = list.map(p => {
    const t = tournaments.find(x => x.id === p.tournamentId) || {};
    const cancelled = getTournamentState(t) === "cancelmatch" || ["CANCELLED","CANCELED","CANCEL MATCH"].includes(String(p.status||"").toUpperCase()) || ["CANCELLED","CANCELED","CANCEL MATCH"].includes(String(p.result||"").toUpperCase()) || p.cancelled === true;
    const r = String(p.result||"").toUpperCase();
    let cls = "res-pending", label = "PENDING", amountHTML = "";
    if(cancelled){
      cls = "res-refund"; label = "CANCELLED";
      amountHTML = `<span class="hist-amount plus">+${money(p.refundAmount || p.entryFee || t.entryFee || 0)}</span>`;
    } else if(r === "WIN"){
      cls = "res-win"; label = "WIN";
      amountHTML = `<span class="hist-amount plus">+${money(p.winAmount || p.prizeAmount || 0)}</span>`;
    } else if(r === "LOSS"){
      cls = "res-loss"; label = "LOSS";
      amountHTML = `<span class="hist-amount" style="color:#8a93aa">No prize</span>`;
    } else if(r === "REFUND" || r === "REFUNDED"){
      cls = "res-refund"; label = "REFUND";

/* ========== SUPPORT ========== */
function supportDailyLimit(){ const n = Number(settings.supportDailyLimit); return Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0 ? n : 3; }
function toMinutes(v){ const m = /^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})$/.exec(String(v||"")); return m ? (Number(m[1])*60 + Number(m[2])) : null; }
function isSupportWindowOpen(){
  if(settings.supportScheduleEnabled !== true) return true;
  const from = toMinutes(settings.supportStartTime), to = toMinutes(settings.supportEndTime);
  if(from == null || to == null) return true;
  const now = new Date(); const cur = now.getHours()*60 + now.getMinutes();
  return from <= to ? (cur >= from && cur <= to) : (cur >= from || cur <= to);
}
function fmtTime(v){
  const m = toMinutes(v); if(m == null) return v || "";
  const h = Math.floor(m/60), mi = String(m%60).padStart(2,"0");
  const ap = h >= 12 ? "PM" : "AM"; const h12 = h % 12 === 0 ? 12 : h % 12;
  return h12 + ":" + mi + " " + ap;
}
function supportScheduleMessage(){
  return settings.supportOffMessage
    || ("Customer Care is open only between " + fmtTime(settings.supportStartTime) + " and " + fmtTime(settings.supportEndTime) + ". Please come back during that time.");
}
function renderSupportSchedule(){
  const box = document.getElementById("supportScheduleBox");
  if(!box) return;
  const open = isSupportWindowOpen();
  const limit = supportDailyLimit();
  if(settings.supportScheduleEnabled === true){
    box.classList.remove("hidden");
    box.innerHTML = (open ? "\u2705 Customer Care is open now" : "\u23f0 Customer Care is closed right now")
      + "<br><b>Timing:</b> " + fmtTime(settings.supportStartTime) + " \u2013 " + fmtTime(settings.supportEndTime)
      + "<br><b>Daily limit:</b> " + limit + " ticket(s) per day";
    box.style.background = open ? "#effaf3" : "#fff4f5";
    box.style.color = open ? "#1a7a4c" : "#b52d43";
  } else {
    box.classList.remove("hidden");
    box.innerHTML = "\u2705 Customer Care is open 24 hours<br><b>Daily limit:</b> " + limit + " ticket(s) per day";
    box.style.background = "#effaf3"; box.style.color = "#1a7a4c";
  }
}
window.renderSupportSchedule = renderSupportSchedule;
window.submitSupportTicket = async function(){
  const subject = document.getElementById("supportSubject").value.trim();
  const message = document.getElementById("supportMessage").value.trim();
  if(isSupportBlocked()){ showSupportBlockedNotice(); return; }
  if(!subject || !message){ showToast("Fill subject and message"); return; }
  if(!isSupportWindowOpen()){ showToast(supportScheduleMessage()); return; }
  const dailyLimit = supportDailyLimit();
  try{
    const mySnap = await getDocs(query(collection(db,"supportTickets"), where("userId","==",currentUser.uid)));
    const myTickets = mySnap.docs.map(d => d.data());
    const openTicket = myTickets.find(t => (t.status||"Pending") !== "Closed" && (t.status||"") !== "Resolved");
    if(openTicket){ showToast("You already have an open ticket. Wait until it is closed."); return; }
    const dayStart = new Date(); dayStart.setHours(0,0,0,0);
    const todayCount = myTickets.filter(t => (t.createdAt?.seconds||0) * 1000 >= dayStart.getTime()).length;
    if(todayCount >= dailyLimit){ showToast("Daily limit reached: only " + dailyLimit + " ticket(s) per day. Try again after 12:00 AM."); return; }

window.copyProfileField = function(id, label){

  const done = () => showToast((label || "Value") + " copied!");
  if(navigator.clipboard?.writeText){
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(value).then(done).catch(() => fallbackCopy(value, done));
  } else {
    fallbackCopy(value, done);
  }
};
function fallbackCopy(value, done){
  try{
    const ta = document.createElement("textarea");
    ta.value = value;
    ta.setAttribute("readonly","");
    ta.style.position = "fixed";
    ta.style.opacity = "0";
    document.body.appendChild(ta);
    ta.select();
    document.execCommand("copy");
    document.body.removeChild(ta);
    done();
  }catch(e){ showToast(value); }
}
