window.refreshAllData = async function(){
  if(!currentUser){ showToast("Please log in first"); return; }
  const btn = document.getElementById("ptrIndicator");
  if(btn){
    if(btn.dataset.busy === "1") return;
    btn.dataset.busy = "1";
    btn.classList.remove("dragging","retracting");
    btn.classList.add("spinning","visible");
    btn.style.setProperty("--ptr-y","8px");
  }
  let failures = 0;
  const step = async (fn, label) => { try{ await fn(); }catch(e){ failures++; console.warn("Refresh step failed:", label, e); } };
  try{
    await step(loadSettings, "settings");
    await step(loadUser, "user");
    await step(loadTournaments, "tournaments");
    await step(refreshWithdrawalState, "withdrawal state");
    await step(refreshDepositState, "deposit state");
    await step(loadDepositHistory, "deposit history");
    await step(loadWithdrawalHistory, "withdrawal history");
    await step(loadMatches, "matches");
    await step(loadNotifications, "notifications");
    await step(autoCreditLeaderboardBonuses, "leaderboard bonuses");
    await step(loadLuckyData, "lucky draw");
    await step(loadTransferHistory, "transfers");
    const active = document.querySelector(".page.active");
    const id = active ? active.id.replace("page-","") : "";
    if(id === "tournaments") await step(async()=>renderTournaments(), "render tournaments");
    if(id === "category") await step(async()=>renderCategoryTournaments(), "render category");
    if(id === "home") await step(async()=>renderCategories(), "render home");
    if(id === "referral") await step(loadMyReferrals, "referrals");
    if(id === "history") await step(loadTournamentHistory, "history");
    if(id === "support") await step(loadSupportHistory, "support");
    if(id === "leaderboard") await step(loadLeaderboard, "leaderboard");
    if(!navigator.onLine) showToast("You are offline. Showing saved data.");
    else showToast(failures ? "Refreshed" : "Data refreshed");
  }catch(e){
    console.error("Refresh error:", e);
    showToast(navigator.onLine ? "Refreshed" : "You are offline. Showing saved data.");
  }finally{
    if(btn){
      btn.dataset.busy = "0";
      btn.classList.remove("spinning");
      btn.classList.add("retracting");
      btn.style.setProperty("--ptr-y","-64px");
      window.setTimeout(function(){
        if(btn.dataset.busy !== "1"){
          btn.classList.remove("visible","retracting");
          btn.style.removeProperty("--ptr-rotation");
        }
      },320);
    }
  }
};

/* ========== PULL-TO-REFRESH GESTURE ========== */
(function(){
  const ptr = document.getElementById("ptrIndicator");
  if(!ptr) return;
  const THRESHOLD = 72, MAX_PULL = 104;
  let startY = 0, lastY = 0, pulling = false, frame = 0;

  function drawPull(){
    frame = 0;
    const distance = Math.max(0,lastY - startY);
    const pull = Math.min(MAX_PULL,distance * .48);
    ptr.style.setProperty("--ptr-y",(pull - 58) + "px");
    ptr.style.setProperty("--ptr-rotation",Math.min(300,distance * 2.4) + "deg");
    ptr.classList.toggle("visible",distance > 4);
  }

  function retract(){
    if(frame){ cancelAnimationFrame(frame); frame = 0; }
    ptr.classList.remove("dragging","spinning");
    ptr.classList.add("retracting");
    ptr.style.setProperty("--ptr-y","-64px");
    window.setTimeout(function(){
      if(ptr.dataset.busy !== "1"){
        ptr.classList.remove("visible","retracting");
        ptr.style.removeProperty("--ptr-rotation");
      }
    },320);
  }

  window.addEventListener("touchstart",function(e){
    if(document.getElementById("app").classList.contains("hidden")) return;
    if(ptr.dataset.busy === "1" || e.touches.length !== 1 || window.scrollY > 0) return;
    if(e.target && e.target.closest && e.target.closest(".modal,.ld-modal,.transfer-sheet,.swipe-track,#swipeThumb,input,textarea")) return;
    if(document.querySelector(".modal:not(.hidden),.ld-modal:not(.hidden)")) return;
    startY = lastY = e.touches[0].clientY;
    pulling = true;
    ptr.classList.remove("retracting");
    ptr.classList.add("dragging");
  },{passive:true});

  window.addEventListener("touchmove",function(e){
    if(!pulling || e.touches.length !== 1) return;
    lastY = e.touches[0].clientY;
    const distance = lastY - startY;
    if(distance <= 0 || window.scrollY > 0){
      pulling = false;
      retract();
      return;
    }
    if(e.cancelable) e.preventDefault();
    if(!frame) frame = requestAnimationFrame(drawPull);
  },{passive:false});

  window.addEventListener("touchend",function(e){
    if(!pulling) return;
    pulling = false;
    if(frame){ cancelAnimationFrame(frame); frame = 0; drawPull(); }
    const endY = e.changedTouches && e.changedTouches[0] ? e.changedTouches[0].clientY : lastY;
    ptr.classList.remove("dragging");
    if(endY - startY >= THRESHOLD && window.scrollY <= 0){
      ptr.classList.add("visible","spinning");
      ptr.style.setProperty("--ptr-y","8px");
      window.refreshAllData();
    }else{
      retract();
    }
  },{passive:true});

  window.addEventListener("touchcancel",function(){
    if(!pulling) return;
    pulling = false;
    retract();
  },{passive:true});
})();

/* ========== AUTOMATED LEADERBOARD BONUSES ========== */
function isLastDayOfMonth(d){
  const n = new Date(d.getTime());
  n.setDate(n.getDate() + 1);
  return n.getDate() === 1;
}
async function getRankedReferrers(){
  const snap = await getDocs(collection(db,"users"));
  const users = snap.docs.map(d => ({ id:d.id, ...d.data() }));
  const counts = lbCountReferrals(users);
  return users
    .map(u => ({ id:u.id, name:u.name || (u.email||"User").split("@")[0], count: counts[u.id] || 0 }))
    .filter(u => u.count > 0)
    .sort((a,b) => b.count - a.count || String(a.name).localeCompare(String(b.name)));
}
async function creditLeaderboardBonus(kind, periodKey, amount, rank){
  const userRef = doc(db,"users", currentUser.uid);
  const field = kind === "weekly" ? "weeklyBonusPeriod" : "monthlyBonusPeriod";
  let credited = false;
  await runTransaction(db, async (tx) => {
    const snap = await tx.get(userRef);
    if(!snap.exists()) return;
    const u = snap.data();
    if(String(u[field] || "") === periodKey) return;
    tx.update(userRef, {
      winningBalance: Number(u.winningBalance||0) + amount,
      [field]: periodKey
    });
    credited = true;
  });
  if(credited){
    try{
      await addDoc(collection(db,"walletTransactions"), {
        userId: currentUser.uid,
        type: kind === "weekly" ? "weekly_leaderboard_bonus" : "monthly_leaderboard_bonus",
        amount,
        reason: `${kind === "weekly" ? "Weekly" : "Monthly"} leaderboard bonus (Rank ${rank})`,
        createdAt: serverTimestamp()
      });
    }catch(e){}
    await loadUser();
    showToast(`${kind === "weekly" ? "Weekly" : "Monthly"} leaderboard bonus ${money(amount)} credited!`);
  }
}
async function autoCreditLeaderboardBonuses(){
  try{
    /* Leaderboard OFF from admin panel => never credit any bonus */
    if(!currentUser || !settings.leaderboardEnabled) return;
    const now = new Date();
    const resetMs = lbResetAt();
    const isSunday = now.getDay() === 0;
    const isMonthEnd = isLastDayOfMonth(now);
    if(!isSunday && !isMonthEnd) return;

    const ranked = await getRankedReferrers();
    const myIndex = ranked.findIndex(u => u.id === currentUser.uid);
    if(myIndex !== 0 && myIndex !== 1) return;
    const amount = Number(myIndex === 0 ? settings.rank1Bonus : settings.rank2Bonus);
    if(!(amount > 0)) return;
    const rank = myIndex + 1;

    /* After a reset the current cycle starts fresh: no bonus for a cycle
       that was already running when the leaderboard was switched back ON. */
    if(isSunday && !(resetMs && resetMs > lbWeekStart(now).getTime())){
      const weekKey = `${now.getFullYear()}-${String(now.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,"0")}-${String(now.getDate()).padStart(2,"0")}`;
      await creditLeaderboardBonus("weekly", weekKey, amount, rank);
    }
    if(isMonthEnd && !(resetMs && resetMs > lbMonthStart(now).getTime())){
      const monthKey = `${now.getFullYear()}-${String(now.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,"0")}`;
      await creditLeaderboardBonus("monthly", monthKey, amount, rank);
    }
  }catch(e){ console.error("Leaderboard bonus error:", e); }
}

/* ===== IN-APP BACK BUTTON HANDLING (no splash re-trigger) ===== */
(function(){
  const rawOpenPage = window.openPage;
  let tmSkipPush = false;
  window.openPage = async function(page){
    const result = await rawOpenPage(page);
    if(!tmSkipPush){
      try{
        const cur = history.state && history.state.tmPage;
        if(cur !== page) history.pushState({tmPage:page}, "", location.href);
      }catch(e){}
    }
    return result;
  };
  try{ history.replaceState({tmPage:"home"}, "", location.href); }catch(e){}
  window.addEventListener("popstate", function(ev){
    const page = (ev.state && ev.state.tmPage) || "home";
    tmSkipPush = true;
    Promise.resolve(window.openPage(page)).catch(()=>{}).then(()=>{ tmSkipPush = false; });
    if(page === "home"){
      try{ history.pushState({tmPage:"home"}, "", location.href); }catch(e){}
    }
  });
  // Android system back button (Cordova/Capacitor WebView): always route to Home
  // so returning from an external action never leaves a blank/loading screen.
  document.addEventListener("backbutton", function(ev){
    try{ if(ev && ev.preventDefault) ev.preventDefault(); }catch(e){}
    tmSkipPush = true;
    Promise.resolve(window.openPage("home")).catch(()=>{}).then(()=>{
      tmSkipPush = false;
      try{ history.replaceState({tmPage:"home"}, "", location.href); }catch(e){}
    });
  }, false);
})();

/* ========== HOME SLIDE BANNER (glassmorphism) ========== */
let bannerTimer = null;
function renderHomeBanners(list){
  const wrap = document.getElementById("homeBannerWrap");
  const track = document.getElementById("homeBannerTrack");
  const dots = document.getElementById("homeBannerDots");
  if(!wrap || !track || !dots) return;
  const items = (Array.isArray(list) ? list : [])
    .map(b => (typeof b === "string"
      ? { url:b, action:"none", actionUrl:"" }
      : { url:(b && b.url) || "", action:(b && b.action) || "none", actionUrl:(b && b.actionUrl) || "" }))
    .filter(b => !!b.url);
  window.__tmBanners = items;
  if(bannerTimer){ clearInterval(bannerTimer); bannerTimer = null; }
  if(!items.length){
    track.innerHTML = "";
    dots.innerHTML = "";
    wrap.classList.add("hidden");
    return;
  }
  wrap.classList.remove("hidden");
  track.innerHTML = items.map((b,i) => `<div class="tm-banner-slide"><img src="${esc(b.url)}" alt="Banner" loading="lazy" style="${b.action && b.action !== "none" ? "cursor:pointer" : ""}" onclick="window.handleBannerClick(${i})" onerror="this.parentNode.style.display='none'"></div>`).join("");
  const prev = document.getElementById("homeBannerPrev");
  const next = document.getElementById("homeBannerNext");
  dots.innerHTML = items.map((_,i) => `<button type="button" class="tm-banner-dot${i===0?" active":""}" aria-label="Show banner ${i+1}" aria-current="${i===0?"true":"false"}"></button>`).join("");
  const hasMany = items.length > 1;
  dots.style.display = hasMany ? "flex" : "none";
  if(prev) prev.style.display = hasMany ? "flex" : "none";
  if(next) next.style.display = hasMany ? "flex" : "none";
  let activeIndex = 0;
  let scrollTick = 0;
  const goTo = (index, smooth = true) => {
    activeIndex = (index + items.length) % items.length;
    track.scrollTo({left:activeIndex * track.clientWidth,behavior:smooth ? "smooth" : "auto"});
    [...dots.children].forEach((dot,i) => {
      dot.classList.toggle("active",i === activeIndex);
      dot.setAttribute("aria-current",i === activeIndex ? "true" : "false");
    });
  };
  const syncDots = () => {
    cancelAnimationFrame(scrollTick);
    scrollTick = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      activeIndex = Math.max(0,Math.min(items.length-1,Math.round(track.scrollLeft / Math.max(1,track.clientWidth))));
      [...dots.children].forEach((dot,i) => {
        dot.classList.toggle("active",i === activeIndex);
        dot.setAttribute("aria-current",i === activeIndex ? "true" : "false");
      });
    });
  };
  track.onscroll = syncDots;
  dots.onclick = event => {
    const button = event.target.closest(".tm-banner-dot");
    if(!button) return;
    goTo([...dots.children].indexOf(button));
  };
  if(prev) prev.onclick = () => goTo(activeIndex-1);
  if(next) next.onclick = () => goTo(activeIndex+1);
  window.addEventListener("resize",() => goTo(activeIndex,false),{passive:true});
  const startAuto = () => {
    if(!hasMany || bannerTimer) return;
    bannerTimer = setInterval(() => {
      if(document.hidden || !document.getElementById("page-home")?.classList.contains("active")) return;
      goTo(activeIndex+1);
    },4500);
  };
  const stopAuto = () => {if(bannerTimer){clearInterval(bannerTimer);bannerTimer=null;}};
  wrap.onmouseenter = stopAuto;
  wrap.onmouseleave = startAuto;
  wrap.ontouchstart = stopAuto;
  wrap.ontouchend = startAuto;
  startAuto();
}

function applyWalletDesign(n){
  let v=Number(n||1); if(!Number.isFinite(v)||v<1||v>30) v=1;
  const t=WALLET_THEME_TOKENS[v-1];
  document.body.setAttribute("data-wd",String(v));
  const style=document.documentElement.style;
  style.setProperty("--tm-primary",t[0]); style.setProperty("--tm-primary-deep",t[1]);
  style.setProperty("--tm-soft",t[2]); style.setProperty("--tm-wallet-bg",t[3]);
  style.setProperty("--tm-accent",t[4]); style.setProperty("--tm-wallet-text",t[5]);
  const hex=String(t[0]).replace("#","");
  const rgb=hex.length===3 ? hex.split("").map(c=>parseInt(c+c,16)) : [0,2,4].map(i=>parseInt(hex.slice(i,i+2),16));
  const linear=rgb.map(c=>{const x=c/255;return x<=.03928?x/12.92:Math.pow((x+.055)/1.055,2.4);});
  const luminance=.2126*linear[0]+.7152*linear[1]+.0722*linear[2];
  style.setProperty("--tm-on-primary",luminance>.46?"#11182d":"#ffffff");
  style.setProperty("--tm-primary-tint",`color-mix(in srgb, ${t[0]} 14%, white)`);
}

window.downloadAppUpdate=function(){
  const up=settings.appUpdate||{};
  const raw=String(up.downloadUrl||"").trim();
  const type=String(up.linkType||"direct").toLowerCase();
  if(!/^https?:\/\//i.test(raw)) return showToast("Download link is unavailable");
  const native=!!(window.cordova||window.Capacitor);
  const openExternal=(url)=>{
    try{
      if(native){ window.open(url,"_system","noopener,noreferrer"); return true; }
      const w=window.open(url,"_blank","noopener,noreferrer");
      if(!w) window.location.assign(url);
      return true;
    }catch(e){ window.location.assign(url); return true; }
  };
  try{
    const u=new URL(raw);
    if(type==="playstore"){
      const pkg=u.searchParams.get("id");
      if(pkg && /Android/i.test(navigator.userAgent)){
        window.location.href="intent://details?id="+pkg+"#Intent;scheme=market;package=com.android.vending;S.browser_fallback_url="+encodeURIComponent(raw)+";end";
        setTimeout(()=>openExternal(raw),1200);
        return;
      }
      if(pkg && !native){ try{ window.location.href="market://details?id="+pkg; setTimeout(()=>openExternal(raw),1200); return; }catch(e){} }
      return void openExternal(raw);
    }
    if(type==="telegram"){
      const path=(u.pathname||"").replace(/^\/+/,"");
      if(/Android/i.test(navigator.userAgent)){
        window.location.href="intent://resolve?domain="+encodeURIComponent(path.split("/")[0])+"#Intent;scheme=tg;package=org.telegram.messenger;S.browser_fallback_url="+encodeURIComponent(raw)+";end";
        setTimeout(()=>openExternal(raw),1200);

let luckyDraws = [];

const LD_SEEN_KEY = "tmLuckySeen";

function ldMs(v){
  if(!v) return 0;
  if(typeof v === "number") return v;
  if(typeof v === "object" && v.seconds) return v.seconds * 1000;
  const t = Date.parse(v);
  return isNaN(t) ? 0 : t;
}
function ldPrizeList(d){ return (Array.isArray(d?.prizes) ? d.prizes : []).map(x => Number(x||0)).filter(x => x > 0); }
function ldPrizeTotal(d){ return ldPrizeList(d).reduce((s,x) => s + x, 0); }
function ldDateText(ms){
  if(!ms) return "—";
  try{ return new Date(ms).toLocaleString("en-IN",{day:"2-digit",month:"short",hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit"}); }
  catch(e){ return "—"; }
}
function ldCountdown(ms){
  const left = ms - Date.now();
  if(left <= 0) return "Closed";
  const d = Math.floor(left/86400000), h = Math.floor(left%86400000/3600000),
        m = Math.floor(left%3600000/60000), s = Math.floor(left%60000/1000);
  const pad = n => String(n).padStart(2,"0");
  return (d > 0 ? d + "d " : "") + pad(h) + ":" + pad(m) + ":" + pad(s);
}

  }catch(e){ luckyDraws = []; }
}

  }
  box.innerHTML = draws.map(d => {
    const prizes = ldPrizeList(d);
    const ticket = luckyTickets.find(t => t.drawId === d.id);
    const startMs = ldMs(d.startAt), closeMs = ldMs(d.closeAt);
    const notStarted = startMs && now < startMs;
    const winnerLimit = Number(d.winnerLimit||0);
    const winnerLimitReached = winnerLimit > 0 && Number(d.winnersCount||0) >= winnerLimit;
    const closed = d.resultDeclared === true || winnerLimitReached || (closeMs && now >= closeMs);
    const fee = Number(d.entryFee||0);
    return `<div class="ld-card">
      ${d.imageUrl ? `<img class="ld-card-img" src="${esc(d.imageUrl)}" alt="${esc(d.name||"Lucky Draw")}" onerror="this.remove()">` : ""}
      <div class="ld-card-body">
        <div class="ld-card-head">
          <div class="ld-name">${esc(d.name || "Lucky Draw")}</div>
          <span class="ld-chip${closed ? " closed" : ""}">${closed ? "Closed" : "Entry " + money(fee)}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="ld-meta">
          <div><small>TOTAL PRIZE</small><b>${money(ldPrizeTotal(d))}</b></div>
          <div><small>${closed ? "STATUS" : notStarted ? "STARTING" : "ENDING"}</small><b class="ld-timer"${closed ? "" : ` data-ld-phase="${notStarted ? "start" : "end"}" data-ld-start="${startMs}" data-ld-close="${closeMs}"`}>${closed ? "Closed" : notStarted ? ldCountdown(startMs) : closeMs ? ldCountdown(closeMs) : "Open"}</b></div>
          <div class="ld-meter-cell"><small>MATCH</small><b class="ld-timer" data-ld-state="1" data-ld-start="${startMs}" data-ld-close="${closeMs}">${closed ? "Live End" : notStarted ? "Upcoming" : "Live now"}</b><div class="ld-meter-track"><div class="ld-meter-fill${closed ? " done" : (!notStarted ? " live" : "")}"></div></div></div>
          <div><button class="ld-prize-cell" onclick="window.openLuckyPrizes('${d.id}')"><small>WINNING PRIZE</small><b>${prizes.length ? prizes.length + " prizes" : "Prizes soon"}</b></button></div>
        </div>
        ${ticket
          ? `<button class="ld-join-btn" disabled>Ticket #${esc(ticket.ticket)} · ${closed ? "Closed" : "Joined"}</button>`
          : closed
            ? `<button class="ld-join-btn" disabled>Closed</button>`
          : notStarted
            ? `<button class="ld-join-btn" disabled>Starts ${ldDateText(startMs)}</button>`
          : (hasPendingDeposit || hasPendingWithdrawal)
            ? `<button class="ld-join-btn" disabled>⏳ ${hasPendingDeposit && !hasPendingWithdrawal ? "Deposit" : "Withdrawal"} Pending</button>`
            : `<button class="ld-join-btn" onclick="window.openLuckyJoin('${d.id}')">Get Ticket · ${money(fee)}</button>`}
        ${closed
          ? `<button class="ld-winbar open" onclick="window.openLuckyWinners('${d.id}')"><span class="ld-winbar-ico">🏆</span> View Winners</button>`
          : `<div class="ld-winbar locked"><span class="ld-winbar-ico">🔒</span> Winners unlock after close</div>`}
      </div>
    </div>`;
  }).join("");
}

function renderLuckyTickets(){
  const box = document.getElementById("ldTicketList");
  if(!box) return;
  if(!luckyTickets.length){
    box.innerHTML = `<div class="ld-empty">🎫 You have no Lucky Draw tickets yet.</div>`;
    return;
  }
  box.innerHTML = luckyTickets.map(t => {
    const status = t.status || "joined";
    const closeMs = ldMs(t.closeAt);
    const cls = status === "won" ? " won" : status === "lost" ? " lost" : "";
    const badge = status === "won"
      ? `<span class="ld-badge win">🏆 Winner ${money(t.winAmount)}</span>`
      : status === "lost"
        ? `<span class="ld-badge loss">🛡️ Next Time Better Luck</span>`
        : `<span class="ld-badge live">● Live</span>`;
    const timer = status === "joined" && closeMs
      ? `<span>Closes in <b class="ld-timer" data-ld-close="${closeMs}">${ldCountdown(closeMs)}</b></span>`
      : `<span>${status === "won" ? "Prize credited to Winning Balance" : status === "lost" ? "Result declared" : "Result awaited"}</span>`;
    return `<div class="ld-ticket${cls}">
      ${status === "won" ? `<span class="ld-shine"></span>` : ""}
      <div class="ld-ticket-top">
        <div class="ld-ticket-name">${esc(t.drawName || "Lucky Draw")}</div>
        ${badge}
      </div>
      <div class="ld-ticket-num">
        <span><small>TICKET NUMBER</small><b>${esc(t.ticket || "----")}</b></span>
        <span style="text-align:right"><small>ENTRY PAID</small><b style="font-size:17px;letter-spacing:0">${money(t.entryFee)}</b></span>
      </div>
      <div class="ld-ticket-foot">${timer}<span>${ldDateText(ldMs(t.createdAt))}</span></div>
    </div>`;
  }).join("");
}

function tickLuckyTimers(){
  let rerender = false;
  const now = Date.now();
  document.querySelectorAll("[data-ld-phase]").forEach(el => {
    const startMs = Number(el.getAttribute("data-ld-start")||0);
    const closeMs = Number(el.getAttribute("data-ld-close")||0);
    const label = el.parentElement?.querySelector("small");
    if(startMs && now < startMs){
      if(label) label.textContent = "STARTING";
      el.dataset.ldPhase = "start";
      el.textContent = ldCountdown(startMs);
    } else if(closeMs && now < closeMs){
      if(label) label.textContent = "ENDING";
      el.dataset.ldPhase = "end";
      el.textContent = ldCountdown(closeMs);
    } else if(closeMs){
      rerender = true;
    } else {
      if(label) label.textContent = "STATUS";
      el.textContent = "Open";
    }
  });
  document.querySelectorAll("[data-ld-state]").forEach(el => {
    const startMs = Number(el.getAttribute("data-ld-start")||0);
    const closeMs = Number(el.getAttribute("data-ld-close")||0);
    el.textContent = closeMs && now >= closeMs ? "Live End" : startMs && now < startMs ? "Upcoming" : "Live now";
    const fill = el.parentElement?.querySelector(".ld-meter-fill");
    if(fill){ fill.classList.toggle("live",(!startMs || now >= startMs) && (!closeMs || now < closeMs)); fill.classList.toggle("done",!!closeMs && now >= closeMs); }
  });
  document.querySelectorAll(".ld-ticket [data-ld-close]").forEach(el => {
    const ms = Number(el.getAttribute("data-ld-close")||0);
    if(ms) el.textContent = ldCountdown(ms);
  });
  if(rerender && document.getElementById("page-luckydraw")?.classList.contains("active")) renderLuckyDraws();
}

window.openLuckyPrizes = function(id){
  const draw = luckyDraws.find(x => x.id === id);
  if(!draw) return;
  const prizes = ldPrizeList(draw);
  const title = document.getElementById("ldPrizeTitle"), list = document.getElementById("ldPrizeList"), modal = document.getElementById("ldPrizeModal");
  if(!title || !list || !modal) return;
  title.textContent = (draw.name || "Lucky Draw") + " · Winning Prizes";
  list.innerHTML = prizes.length ? prizes.map((amount,index)=>`<div class="ld-prize-item"><span class="ld-prize-rank">#${index+1} Winner</span><span class="ld-prize-amount">${money(amount)}</span></div>`).join("") : `<div class="ld-empty">Prizes will be announced soon.</div>`;

};
window.closeLuckyPrizes = function(){ document.getElementById("ldPrizeModal")?.classList.add("hidden"); };

window.openLuckyTickets = function(){
  clearLuckyDot();
  renderLuckyTickets();
  window.openPage("luckytickets");
  loadLuckyTicketsOnce().then(()=>{ renderLuckyTickets(); updateLuckyDot(); }).catch(()=>{});

window.openLuckyJoin = function(id){
  const d = luckyDraws.find(x => x.id === id);
  if(!d) return showToast("Match unavailable");
  if(hasPendingDeposit || hasPendingWithdrawal) return showToast(hasPendingDeposit && !hasPendingWithdrawal ? "Cannot join Lucky Draw while a deposit is pending. Wait for TMGame approval." : "Cannot join Lucky Draw while a withdrawal is pending. Wait for TMGame approval.");
  const limit = Number(d.winnerLimit||0);
  if(d.resultDeclared === true || (limit > 0 && Number(d.winnersCount||0) >= limit) || (ldMs(d.closeAt) && Date.now() >= ldMs(d.closeAt))) return showToast("This match is closed");
  luckySelectedDraw = d;
  const prizes = ldPrizeList(d);
  document.getElementById("ldJoinBill").innerHTML =
    `<div><span>Match</span><b>${esc(d.name||"Lucky Draw")}</b></div>
     <div><span>Prizes</span><b>${prizes.length ? prizes.map(p => money(p)).join(" · ") : "—"}</b></div>
     <div><span>Total prize pool</span><b>${money(ldPrizeTotal(d))}</b></div>
     <div><span>Starts</span><b>${ldDateText(ldMs(d.startAt))}</b></div>
     <div><span>Closes</span><b>${ldDateText(ldMs(d.closeAt))}</b></div>
     <div><span>Entry fee</span><b>${money(d.entryFee)}</b></div>
     <div><span>Available balance</span><b>${money(currentUserData?.walletBalance)}</b></div>
     <div><span>Payable now</span><b>${money(d.entryFee)}</b></div>`;
  document.getElementById("ldJoinBody").classList.remove("hidden");
  document.getElementById("ldJoinLoading").classList.add("hidden");
  document.getElementById("ldJoinSuccess").classList.add("hidden");
  document.getElementById("ldJoinModal").classList.remove("hidden");
};

window.openLuckyWinners = async function(id){
  const d = luckyDraws.find(x => x.id === id);
  const box = document.getElementById("ldWinnersScroll");
  const sub = document.getElementById("ldWinnersSub");
  if(!box) return;
  sub.textContent = (d?.name || "Lucky Draw") + " · Result declared";
  box.innerHTML = `<div class="ld-state"><div class="ld-spinner"></div></div>`;
  document.getElementById("ldWinnersModal").classList.remove("hidden");
  let rows = [];
  try{
    const snap = await getDocs(query(collection(db,"luckyTickets"), where("drawId","==",id), where("status","==","won")));
    snap.forEach(s => { const t = s.data(); rows.push({ name: t.userName || "Winner", amount: Number(t.winAmount||0), ticket: t.ticket || "----" }); });
    rows.sort((a,b) => b.amount - a.amount);
  }catch(e){ box.innerHTML = `<div class="ld-empty">Winners list unavailable right now.</div>`; return; }
  box.innerHTML = rows.length
    ? rows.map((w,i) => `<div class="ld-winrow${i === 0 ? " top" : ""}" style="animation-delay:${i*0.06}s">
        <span class="ld-winrank">#${i+1}</span>
        <span class="ld-wininfo"><span class="ld-winname">${esc(w.name)}</span><span class="ld-winticket">TICKET ${esc(w.ticket)}</span></span>
        <span class="ld-winamt">${money(w.amount)}</span>
      </div>`).join("")
    : `<div class="ld-empty">🏆 No winners declared for this match.</div>`;
};

window.closeLuckyWinners = function(){
  document.getElementById("ldWinnersModal").classList.add("hidden");
};

window.closeLuckyJoin = function(){
  document.getElementById("ldJoinModal").classList.add("hidden");
  luckySelectedDraw = null;
};

window.confirmLuckyJoin = async function(){
  const d = luckySelectedDraw;
  if(!d || !currentUser) return;
  if(hasPendingDeposit || hasPendingWithdrawal){ showToast(hasPendingDeposit && !hasPendingWithdrawal ? "Cannot join Lucky Draw while a deposit is pending" : "Cannot join Lucky Draw while a withdrawal is pending"); return; }
  document.getElementById("ldJoinBody").classList.add("hidden");
  document.getElementById("ldJoinLoading").classList.remove("hidden");
  let ticketNumber = "";
  try{
    await runTransaction(db, async tx => {
      const drawRef = doc(db,"luckyDraws",d.id);
      const ticketRef = doc(db,"luckyTickets", d.id + "_" + currentUser.uid);
      const userRef = doc(db,"users",currentUser.uid);
      const [ds, ts, us] = await Promise.all([tx.get(drawRef), tx.get(ticketRef), tx.get(userRef)]);
      if(!ds.exists()) throw new Error("This match is no longer available");
      if(ts.exists()) throw new Error("You already have a ticket for this match");
      if(!us.exists()) throw new Error("Account unavailable");
      const data = ds.data();
      const closeMs = ldMs(data.closeAt);
      const winnerLimit = Number(data.winnerLimit||0);
      if(data.resultDeclared === true || (winnerLimit > 0 && Number(data.winnersCount||0) >= winnerLimit) || (closeMs && Date.now() >= closeMs)) throw new Error("This match is closed");
      const startMs = ldMs(data.startAt);
      if(startMs && Date.now() < startMs) throw new Error("This match has not started yet");
      const fee = Number(data.entryFee||0);
      const balance = Number(us.data().walletBalance||0);
      if(fee > balance) throw new Error("Insufficient available balance");
      const used = Array.isArray(data.usedTickets) ? data.usedTickets.slice() : [];
      let num = "", guard = 0;
      do{ num = String(Math.floor(1000 + Math.random()*9000)); guard++; }
      while(used.includes(num) && guard < 9000);
      if(used.includes(num)) throw new Error("Tickets sold out for this match");
      used.push(num);
      ticketNumber = num;
      tx.update(userRef, { walletBalance: balance - fee });
      tx.update(drawRef, { usedTickets: used, joinedCount: Number(data.joinedCount||0) + 1 });
      tx.set(ticketRef, {
        drawId: d.id,
        drawName: data.name || "Lucky Draw",
        ticket: num,
        uid: currentUser.uid,
        userName: currentUserData?.name || "User",
        userEmail: currentUserData?.email || "",
        accountNumber: currentUserData?.tmgameAccountNumber || "",
        entryFee: fee,
        prizeTotal: (Array.isArray(data.prizes)?data.prizes:[]).reduce((s,x)=>s+Number(x||0),0),
        closeAt: closeMs,
        status: "joined",
        winAmount: 0,
        celebrationSeen: false,
        createdAt: serverTimestamp()
      });
    });
    /* Ticket booked: show success immediately, refresh in background */
    const localTicket = { id: d.id + "_" + currentUser.uid, drawId: d.id, drawName: d.name || "Lucky Draw", ticket: ticketNumber, uid: currentUser.uid, entryFee: Number(d.entryFee||0), closeAt: ldMs(d.closeAt), status: "joined", winAmount: 0, createdAt: Date.now() };
    if(!luckyTickets.some(t => t.id === localTicket.id)) luckyTickets.unshift(localTicket);
    if(currentUserData){ currentUserData.walletBalance = Math.max(0, Number(currentUserData.walletBalance||0) - Number(d.entryFee||0)); try{ updateUserUI(); }catch(e){} }
    document.getElementById("ldJoinLoading").classList.add("hidden");
    document.getElementById("ldJoinSuccessNum").textContent = "Your ticket number is " + ticketNumber;
    document.getElementById("ldJoinSuccess").classList.remove("hidden");
    showToast("🎟️ Ticket booked successfully!");
    try{ if(navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate([30,40,60]); }catch(e){}
    renderLuckyTickets(); renderLuckyDraws(); updateLuckyDot();
    loadUser().catch(()=>{});
    loadLuckyDraws().then(()=>{ renderLuckyDraws(); }).catch(()=>{});
    loadLuckyTicketsOnce().then(()=>{ renderLuckyTickets(); renderLuckyDraws(); updateLuckyDot(); }).catch(()=>{});
  }catch(e){
    document.getElementById("ldJoinLoading").classList.add("hidden");
    document.getElementById("ldJoinBody").classList.remove("hidden");
    showToast(e.message || "Could not buy ticket");
  }
};

function ldFireConfetti(){
  const box = document.getElementById("ldConfetti");
  if(!box) return;
  const colors = ["#f6c343","#ff5ba7","#4f8bff","#22c55e","#ff8a3d","#a855f7"];
  box.innerHTML = "";
  for(let i = 0; i < 90; i++){
    const piece = document.createElement("i");
    piece.style.left = Math.random()*100 + "%";
    piece.style.background = colors[i % colors.length];
    piece.style.animationDuration = (2.2 + Math.random()*1.8) + "s";
    piece.style.animationDelay = (Math.random()*0.7) + "s";
    piece.style.transform = "rotate(" + Math.random()*360 + "deg)";
    box.appendChild(piece);
  }
  box.classList.remove("hidden");
  setTimeout(() => { box.classList.add("hidden"); box.innerHTML = ""; }, 5200);
}

async function showLuckyWinner(ticket){
  if(!ticket || ticket.celebrationSeen) return;
  ticket.celebrationSeen = true;
  document.getElementById("ldWinAmount").textContent = money(ticket.winAmount);
  document.getElementById("ldWinInfo").textContent =
    (ticket.drawName || "Lucky Draw") + " · Ticket #" + (ticket.ticket || "----") + " · Added to your Winning Balance";
  document.getElementById("ldWinModal").classList.remove("hidden");
  ldFireConfetti();
  try{ await updateDoc(doc(db,"luckyTickets",ticket.id), { celebrationSeen: true }); }catch(e){}
  try{ await loadUser(); }catch(e){}
}

window.closeLuckyWin = function(){
  document.getElementById("ldWinModal").classList.add("hidden");
  document.getElementById("ldConfetti").classList.add("hidden");
};

async function loadLuckyData(){
  await loadLuckyDraws();
  await loadLuckyTicketsOnce();
  watchLuckyTickets();
  renderLuckyDraws();
  renderLuckyTickets();
  updateLuckyDot();
  if(!luckyTimerInt) luckyTimerInt = setInterval(tickLuckyTimers, 1000);
}

<script>
/* Visual-only observer for the existing async button states. */
(function(){
  const ids = ["depositSubmitBtn","withdrawSubmitBtn","confirmJoinBtn"];
  function syncLoadingState(){
    ids.forEach(id => {
      const button = document.getElementById(id);
      if(!button) return;
      const waiting = button.disabled && /Submitting|Processing|Joining/i.test(button.textContent || "");
      button.classList.toggle("tm-processing", waiting);
      if(waiting) button.setAttribute("aria-busy","true");
      else button.removeAttribute("aria-busy");
    });
  }
  const start = () => {
    syncLoadingState();
    const observer = new MutationObserver(syncLoadingState);
    observer.observe(document.body,{subtree:true,childList:true,characterData:true,attributes:true,attributeFilter:["disabled"]});
  };
  if(document.readyState === "loading") document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded",start,{once:true});
  else start();
})();
</script>
<script>
/* Visual-only touch feedback and unread notification indicator. */
(function(){
  function getButton(target){
    return target && target.closest ? target.closest("button") : null;
  }
  document.addEventListener("click",function(event){
    const button = getButton(event.target);
    if(!button || button.disabled) return;
    button.classList.remove("tm-tap-feedback");
    void button.offsetWidth;
    button.classList.add("tm-tap-feedback");
    window.setTimeout(() => button.classList.remove("tm-tap-feedback"),320);
  },{passive:true});

  function syncNotificationDot(){
    const bell = document.getElementById("headerNotification");
    const list = document.getElementById("notificationList");
    if(!bell || !list) return;
    bell.classList.toggle("has-unread",!!list.querySelector(".notif-item.unread"));
  }
  const start = () => {
    syncNotificationDot();
    const observer = new MutationObserver(syncNotificationDot);
    const list = document.getElementById("notificationList");
    if(list) observer.observe(list,{subtree:true,childList:true,characterData:true});
  };
  if(document.readyState === "loading") document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded",start,{once:true});
  else start();
})();
</script>
<script>
/* Safety fallback: if for any reason the module script cannot load,
   reveal the auth page after 20s instead of leaving the splash forever. */
(function(){
  window.setTimeout(function(){
    var splash = document.getElementById("splashScreen");
    if(splash && !splash.classList.contains("hidden")){
      splash.classList.add("splash-hide");
      window.setTimeout(function(){ splash.classList.add("hidden"); }, 520);
      var authPage = document.getElementById("authPage");
      var appPage = document.getElementById("app");
      if(authPage && appPage && appPage.classList.contains("hidden") && document.body.dataset.authState !== "signed-in" && navigator.onLine){
        authPage.classList.remove("hidden");
      }
    }
  }, 20000);
})();
</script>
